name: bs_pde_eq_itoDrift2D_minus_rV
statement:
theorem bs_pde_eq_itoDrift2D_minus_rV (r σ S V V_S V_SS V_t : ℝ) :
    V_t + r * S * V_S + (1 / 2) * σ ^ 2 * S ^ 2 * V_SS - r * V =
      itoDrift2D V_t V_S V_SS (r * S) (σ * S) - r * V
proof:
:= by
  unfold itoDrift2D
  ring

name: chooser_payoff_decompose
statement:
lemma chooser_payoff_decompose (C P : ℝ) :
    max C P = C + max 0 (P - C)
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : C ≤ P
  · rw [max_eq_right h, max_eq_right (by linarith : (0:ℝ) ≤ P - C)]; ring
  · push Not at h
    rw [max_eq_left h.le, max_eq_left (by linarith : P - C ≤ 0)]; ring

name: chooser_via_pcp
statement:
lemma chooser_via_pcp (C P S K_disc : ℝ) (hPCP : C - P = S - K_disc) :
    max C P = C + max 0 (K_disc - S)
proof:
:= by
  rw [chooser_payoff_decompose]
  have : P - C = K_disc - S := by linarith
  rw [this]

name: margrabe_variance_sub
statement:
theorem margrabe_variance_sub {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {L₁ L₂ : Ω → ℝ} (h₁ : MemLp L₁ 2 P) (h₂ : MemLp L₂ 2 P) :
    Var[L₁ - L₂; P] = Var[L₁; P] + Var[L₂; P] - 2 * cov[L₁, L₂; P]
proof:
:= by
  rw [← covariance_self (h₁.sub h₂).aemeasurable,
      covariance_sub_left h₁ h₂ (h₁.sub h₂),
      covariance_sub_right h₁ h₁ h₂, covariance_sub_right h₂ h₁ h₂,
      covariance_self h₁.aemeasurable, covariance_self h₂.aemeasurable,
      covariance_comm L₂ L₁]
  ring

name: margrabe_effective_variance
statement:
theorem margrabe_effective_variance {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {P : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure P]
    {L₁ L₂ : Ω → ℝ} {σ₁ σ₂ ρ T : ℝ}
    (h₁ : MemLp L₁ 2 P) (h₂ : MemLp L₂ 2 P)
    (hV₁ : Var[L₁; P] = σ₁ ^ 2 * T) (hV₂ : Var[L₂; P] = σ₂ ^ 2 * T)
    (hcov : cov[L₁, L₂; P] = ρ * σ₁ * σ₂ * T) :
    Var[L₁ - L₂; P] = (σ₁ ^ 2 + σ₂ ^ 2 - 2 * ρ * σ₁ * σ₂) * T
proof:
:= by
  rw [margrabe_variance_sub h₁ h₂, hV₁, hV₂, hcov]
  ring

name: exchange_payoff_eq_ratio
statement:
theorem exchange_payoff_eq_ratio (a b : ℝ) (hb : 0 < b) :
    max (a - b) 0 = b * max (a / b - 1) 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [mul_max_of_nonneg _ _ hb.le, mul_zero,
      show b * (a / b - 1) = a - b from by field_simp]

name: margrabe_eq_bsVGarman
statement:
theorem margrabe_eq_bsVGarman (S1 S2 σ T : ℝ) :
    margrabePrice S1 S2 σ T = bsVGarman S1 S2 1 σ T
proof:
:= by
  have hd1 : margrabeD1 S1 S2 σ T = gbsd1 S1 S2 1 σ T := by
    unfold margrabeD1 gbsd1; rw [mul_one]
  unfold margrabePrice bsVGarman margrabeD2 gbsd2
  rw [hd1, mul_one]

name: margrabe_parity
statement:
theorem margrabe_parity (S1 S2 σ T : ℝ)
    (hS1 : 0 < S1) (hS2 : 0 < S2) (hσ : σ ≠ 0) (hT : 0 < T) :
    margrabePrice S1 S2 σ T - margrabePrice S2 S1 σ T = S1 - S2
proof:
:= by
  have hσT : σ * Real.sqrt T ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hσ (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT).ne'
  
  have hsum : margrabeD1 S2 S1 σ T + margrabeD1 S1 S2 σ T = σ * Real.sqrt T := by
    unfold margrabeD1
    rw [← add_div, Real.log_div hS2.ne' hS1.ne', Real.log_div hS1.ne' hS2.ne',
        show (Real.log S2 - Real.log S1 + σ ^ 2 * T / 2)
              + (Real.log S1 - Real.log S2 + σ ^ 2 * T / 2) = σ ^ 2 * T from by ring,
        div_eq_iff hσT,
        show σ * Real.sqrt T * (σ * Real.sqrt T)
              = σ ^ 2 * (Real.sqrt T * Real.sqrt T) from by ring,
        Real.mul_self_sqrt hT.le]
  
  have hd1 : margrabeD1 S2 S1 σ T = -(margrabeD2 S1 S2 σ T) := by
    unfold margrabeD2; linarith [hsum]
  have hd2 : margrabeD2 S2 S1 σ T = -(margrabeD1 S1 S2 σ T) := by
    unfold margrabeD2; linarith [hsum]
  unfold margrabePrice
  rw [hd1, hd2, Phi_neg, Phi_neg]
  ring

name: bsd1_ratio_eq_margrabeD1
statement:
private lemma bsd1_ratio_eq_margrabeD1 (S1 S2 σ T : ℝ) :
    bsd1 (S1 / S2) 1 0 σ T = margrabeD1 S1 S2 σ T
proof:
:= by
  unfold bsd1 margrabeD1
  rw [div_one]; congr 1; ring

name: bsd2_ratio_eq_margrabeD2
statement:
private lemma bsd2_ratio_eq_margrabeD2 (S1 S2 σ T : ℝ) :
    bsd2 (S1 / S2) 1 0 σ T = margrabeD2 S1 S2 σ T
proof:
:= by
  unfold bsd2 margrabeD2
  rw [bsd1_ratio_eq_margrabeD1]

name: margrabe_price_via_call
statement:
theorem margrabe_price_via_call
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S1 S2 σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ} (hS2 : 0 < S2)
    (h : BSCallHyp Q (S1 / S2) 1 0 σ T Z) :
    S2 * ∫ ω, max (bsTerminal (S1 / S2) 0 σ T (Z ω) - 1) 0 ∂Q
      = margrabePrice S1 S2 σ T
proof:
:= by
  have hbs := bs_call_formula h
  simp only [neg_zero, zero_mul, Real.exp_zero, one_mul, mul_one] at hbs
  rw [hbs, bsd1_ratio_eq_margrabeD1, bsd2_ratio_eq_margrabeD2]
  unfold margrabePrice
  field_simp

name: exchangeOption_numeraire_price
statement:
theorem exchangeOption_numeraire_price
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    (Q : Measure Ω) (S1T S2T : Ω → ℝ) (S2_0 : ℝ)
    (hS2meas : Measurable S2T) (hS2pos : ∀ ω, 0 < S2T ω) (hS20 : 0 < S2_0) :
    S2_0 * ∫ ω, max (S1T ω / S2T ω - 1) 0
        ∂(numeraireMeasure Q (fun _ ↦ 1) S2T 1 S2_0)
      = ∫ ω, max (S1T ω - S2T ω) 0 ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  have hL : ∀ ω, max (S1T ω / S2T ω - 1) 0 = max (S1T ω - S2T ω) 0 / S2T ω := fun ω ↦ by
    rw [exchange_payoff_eq_ratio (S1T ω) (S2T ω) (hS2pos ω),
        mul_div_cancel_left₀ _ (hS2pos ω).ne']
  have hkey := changeOfNumeraire (Q := Q) (X := fun ω ↦ max (S1T ω - S2T ω) 0)
      (BT := fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) (NT := S2T) (B0 := (1 : ℝ)) (N0 := S2_0)
      hS2meas measurable_const hS2pos (fun _ ↦ one_pos) zero_le_one hS20
  simp_rw [div_one, one_mul] at hkey
  simp_rw [hL]
  exact hkey

name: convexOn_sub_const_id
statement:
lemma convexOn_sub_const_id (a : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun K : ℝ ↦ a - K)
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨convex_univ, fun K₁ _ K₂ _ s t _ _ hst ↦ ?_⟩
  show a - (s • K₁ + t • K₂) ≤ s • (a - K₁) + t • (a - K₂)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  
  have h_sa_ta : s * a + t * a = a := by linear_combination a * hst
  linarith

name: convexOn_call_payoff
statement:
lemma convexOn_call_payoff (S : ℝ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun K : ℝ ↦ max (S - K) 0)
proof:
:=
  (convexOn_sub_const_id S).sup (convexOn_const (0 : ℝ) convex_univ)

name: antitone_call_payoff
statement:
lemma antitone_call_payoff (S : ℝ) :
    Antitone (fun K : ℝ ↦ max (S - K) 0)
proof:
:=
  fun _ _ h ↦ max_le_max (by linarith) le_rfl

name: deriv_bsV_eq_on_Ioi
statement:
private lemma deriv_bsV_eq_on_Ioi (S r σ τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) {K : ℝ} (hK : K ∈ Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) :
    deriv (fun k ↦ bsV k r σ S τ) K =
      -(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ))
proof:
:=
  (hasDerivAt_bsV_K (S := S) (r := r) (σ := σ) hS hσ hK hτ).deriv

name: deriv_bsV_eventuallyEq
statement:
private lemma deriv_bsV_eventuallyEq (S r σ τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    (hτ : 0 < τ) {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    (fun K' ↦ deriv (fun k ↦ bsV k r σ S τ) K') =ᶠ[nhds K]
      (fun K' ↦ -(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K' r σ τ)))
proof:
:= by
  filter_upwards [isOpen_Ioi.mem_nhds (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr hK)] with K' hK'
  exact deriv_bsV_eq_on_Ioi S r σ τ hS hσ hτ hK'

name: bsV_strike_convexOn
statement:
theorem bsV_strike_convexOn {S r σ τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (fun K ↦ bsV K r σ S τ)
proof:
:= by
  refine convexOn_of_deriv2_nonneg' (convex_Ioi 0) ?_ ?_ ?_
  
  · intro K hK
    exact ((hasDerivAt_bsV_K (S := S) (r := r) (σ := σ) hS hσ hK hτ).differentiableAt
      ).differentiableWithinAt
  
  · intro K hK
    have h_pos : 0 < K := hK
    have h_KK := hasDerivAt_bsV_KK (S := S) (r := r) (σ := σ) hS hσ h_pos hτ
    have h_ev := deriv_bsV_eventuallyEq S r σ τ hS hσ hτ h_pos
    exact ((h_KK.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).differentiableAt).differentiableWithinAt
  
  · intro K hK
    have h_pos : 0 < K := hK
    have h_KK := hasDerivAt_bsV_KK (S := S) (r := r) (σ := σ) hS hσ h_pos hτ
    have h_ev := deriv_bsV_eventuallyEq S r σ τ hS hσ hτ h_pos
    have h_d2 : deriv^[2] (fun k ↦ bsV k r σ S τ) K =
        Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) /
          (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ) :=
      (h_KK.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_ev).deriv
    rw [h_d2]
    
    
    exact bsV_partial_KK_nonneg h_pos hσ hτ S r

name: bsP_strike_convexOn
statement:
theorem bsP_strike_convexOn {S r σ τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    ConvexOn ℝ (Set.Ioi (0 : ℝ)) (fun K ↦ bsP K r σ S τ)
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : (fun K ↦ bsP K r σ S τ)
      = (fun K ↦ bsV K r σ S τ) + (fun K ↦ K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) - S) := by
    funext K; simp only [Pi.add_apply]; rw [bsP_eq_bsV K r σ S τ]; ring
  rw [h_eq]
  refine (bsV_strike_convexOn hS hσ hτ).add ⟨convex_Ioi 0, fun K₁ _ K₂ _ s t _ _ hst ↦ ?_⟩
  dsimp only
  simp only [smul_eq_mul]
  nlinarith [show s * S + t * S = S from by linear_combination S * hst]

name: riskNeutralProb_S_T_gt_K
statement:
theorem riskNeutralProb_S_T_gt_K
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    (Q {ω | bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) > K}).toReal =
      Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hS_0, hK, hσ, hT, hZ⟩ := h
  
  have h_set_eq :
      {ω | bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) > K} = Z ⁻¹' Set.Ioi (-bsd2 S_0 K r σ T) := by
    ext ω
    rw [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_preimage, Set.mem_Ioi]
    exact bsTerminal_gt_K_iff hS_0 hK hσ hT (Z ω)
  rw [h_set_eq]
  
  have h_meas : AEMeasurable Z Q := hZ.aemeasurable
  rw [← Measure.map_apply_of_aemeasurable h_meas measurableSet_Ioi]
  rw [hZ.map_eq]
  
  rw [gaussianReal_Ioi_toReal]
  congr 1; ring

name: bull_call_spread_payoff_le
statement:
lemma bull_call_spread_payoff_le (S K₁ K₂ : ℝ) (h : K₁ ≤ K₂) :
    max (S - K₂) 0 ≤ max (S - K₁) 0
proof:
:=
  antitone_call_payoff S h

name: butterfly_payoff_nonneg
statement:
lemma butterfly_payoff_nonneg (S K₁ K₃ : ℝ) (_h : K₁ ≤ K₃) :
    0 ≤
      max (S - K₁) 0 -
        2 * max (S - (K₁ + K₃) / 2) 0 +
        max (S - K₃) 0
proof:
:= by
  
  have h_conv := (convexOn_call_payoff S).2 (Set.mem_univ K₁) (Set.mem_univ K₃)
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2)
    (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) ≤ 1/2)
    (by norm_num : (1/2:ℝ) + 1/2 = 1)
  simp only [smul_eq_mul] at h_conv
  rw [show (1/2 * K₁ + 1/2 * K₃ : ℝ) = (K₁ + K₃) / 2 from by ring] at h_conv
  
  
  linarith

name: hasDerivAt_bsd1_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsd1_K (S r σ τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ bsd1 S k r σ τ) (-(1 / (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ))) K
proof:
:= by
  have h_sqrt_τ_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_τ_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_τ_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have hK_ne : K ≠ 0 := hK.ne'
  
  have h_log : HasDerivAt Real.log (1 / K) K := by
    rw [one_div]; exact Real.hasDerivAt_log hK_ne
  
  have h_minus_log : HasDerivAt
      (fun k : ℝ ↦ Real.log S - Real.log k) (-(1 / K)) K := by
    have h_neg := h_log.neg
    have h_add := h_neg.const_add (Real.log S)
    have : (fun k : ℝ ↦ Real.log S - Real.log k) = fun x ↦ Real.log S + (-Real.log) x := by
      funext x; simp [sub_eq_add_neg]
    rw [this]; exact h_add
  
  have h_eventually : (fun k : ℝ ↦ Real.log (S / k)) =ᶠ[nhds K]
                       (fun k ↦ Real.log S - Real.log k) := by
    filter_upwards [eventually_ne_nhds hK_ne] with k hk
    exact Real.log_div hS.ne' hk
  have h_log_div : HasDerivAt (fun k : ℝ ↦ Real.log (S / k)) (-(1 / K)) K :=
    h_minus_log.congr_of_eventuallyEq h_eventually
  
  have h_num : HasDerivAt
      (fun k : ℝ ↦ Real.log (S / k) + (r + σ ^ 2 / 2) * τ) (-(1 / K)) K := by
    simpa using h_log_div.add_const ((r + σ ^ 2 / 2) * τ)
  
  have h_div_στ : HasDerivAt
      (fun k : ℝ ↦ (Real.log (S / k) + (r + σ ^ 2 / 2) * τ) / (σ * Real.sqrt τ))
      (-(1 / K) / (σ * Real.sqrt τ)) K :=
    h_num.div_const (σ * Real.sqrt τ)
  have h_val_eq :
      -(1 / K) / (σ * Real.sqrt τ) = -(1 / (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ)) := by
    field_simp
  rw [h_val_eq] at h_div_στ
  exact h_div_στ

name: hasDerivAt_bsd2_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsd2_K (S r σ τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    {K : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ bsd2 S k r σ τ) (-(1 / (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ))) K
proof:
:= by
  have h_diff := (hasDerivAt_bsd1_K S r σ τ hS hσ hτ hK).sub_const (σ * Real.sqrt τ)
  have h_fun_eq : (fun k : ℝ ↦ bsd1 S k r σ τ - σ * Real.sqrt τ)
        = (fun k : ℝ ↦ bsd2 S k r σ τ) := by
    funext k; rw [bsd2]
  rw [← h_fun_eq]
  exact h_diff

name: hasDerivAt_bsV_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsV_K {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ bsV k r σ S τ)
      (-(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ))) K
proof:
:= by
  have h_sqrt_τ_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_τ_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_τ_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have hK_ne : K ≠ 0 := hK.ne'
  have hS_ne : S ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
  
  have h_d1_K := hasDerivAt_bsd1_K S r σ τ hS hσ hτ hK
  have h_d2_K := hasDerivAt_bsd2_K S r σ τ hS hσ hτ hK
  have h_Phi_d1 := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ)).comp K h_d1_K
  have h_Phi_d2 := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp K h_d2_K
  
  have h_S_Phi_d1 := h_Phi_d1.const_mul S
  
  have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun k : ℝ ↦ k) 1 K := hasDerivAt_id K
  have h_K_Phi_d2 := h_id.mul h_Phi_d2
  have h_K_exp_Phi_d2 := h_K_Phi_d2.const_mul (Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
  have h_V := h_S_Phi_d1.sub h_K_exp_Phi_d2
  have h_fun_eq : (fun k : ℝ ↦
        S * Phi (bsd1 S k r σ τ) -
        Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * (k * Phi (bsd2 S k r σ τ))) =
      (fun k : ℝ ↦ bsV k r σ S τ) := by
    funext k
    show S * Phi (bsd1 S k r σ τ) -
          Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * (k * Phi (bsd2 S k r σ τ)) =
        bsV k r σ S τ
    unfold bsV
    ring
  rw [← h_fun_eq]
  
  have h_bs := bs_identity (r := r) hS hK hσ hτ
  have hKστ_ne : K * σ * Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := by positivity
  refine h_V.congr_deriv ?_
  
  
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  have hKστ_pos : (0 : ℝ) < K * σ * Real.sqrt τ := by positivity
  field_simp
  linarith [h_bs]

name: hasDerivAt_bsP_K
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_K {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ bsP k r σ S τ)
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ)) K
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : (fun k : ℝ ↦ bsP k r σ S τ) =
        fun k ↦ bsV k r σ S τ - S + k * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := by
    funext k; rw [bsP_eq_bsV k r σ S τ]
  rw [h_eq]
  have h_V := hasDerivAt_bsV_K (S := S) (r := r) (σ := σ) hS hσ hK hτ
  have h_const : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ ↦ S) 0 K := hasDerivAt_const K S
  have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun k : ℝ ↦ k * Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ))) K := by
    have := (hasDerivAt_id K).mul_const (Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
    simpa using this
  have h := (h_V.sub h_const).add h_lin
  
  have h_Phi := Phi_neg (bsd2 S K r σ τ)
  
  have h1 := h.congr_of_eventuallyEq (f₁ := fun k ↦ bsV k r σ S τ - S + k * Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun k ↦ by simp only [Pi.add_apply, Pi.sub_apply])
  
  have hval : -(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)) - 0 + Real.exp (-(r * τ))
      = Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ) := by
    have : Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ) =
        Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * (1 - Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)) := by rw [h_Phi]
    linarith [mul_comm (Real.exp (-(r * τ))) (Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ))]
  exact hval ▸ h1

name: hasDerivAt_bsV_KK
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsV_KK {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ -(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S k r σ τ)))
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) /
        (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ)) K
proof:
:= by
  have h_d2_K := hasDerivAt_bsd2_K S r σ τ hS hσ hτ hK
  have h_Phi_d2 := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp K h_d2_K
  have h := (h_Phi_d2.const_mul (Real.exp (-(r * τ)))).neg
  have h_sqrt_τ_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ).ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have hK_ne : K ≠ 0 := hK.ne'
  refine h.congr_deriv ?_
  
  field_simp

name: hasDerivAt_bsP_KK
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsP_KK {S r σ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun k ↦ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S k r σ τ))
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) *
        gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) /
        (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ)) K
proof:
:= by
  have h_d2_K := hasDerivAt_bsd2_K S r σ τ hS hσ hτ hK
  have h_neg_d2 := h_d2_K.neg
  have h_Phi_neg_d2 := (hasDerivAt_Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp K h_neg_d2
  have h := h_Phi_neg_d2.const_mul (Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
  have h_pdf_sym : gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (-bsd2 S K r σ τ) =
      gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) := gaussianPDFReal_zero_one_neg _
  have h_sqrt_τ_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_τ_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_τ_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have hK_ne : K ≠ 0 := hK.ne'
  have h1 := h.congr_of_eventuallyEq
    (f₁ := fun k ↦ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S k r σ τ))
    (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun x ↦ by simp only [Function.comp_def, Pi.neg_apply])
  refine h1.congr_deriv ?_
  rw [h_pdf_sym]
  field_simp

name: gaussianReal_Iic_toReal
statement:
lemma gaussianReal_Iic_toReal (a : ℝ) :
    (gaussianReal 0 1 (Set.Iic a)).toReal = Phi a
proof: := rfl

name: integral_exp_mul_gaussianPDFReal_Iic
statement:
lemma integral_exp_mul_gaussianPDFReal_Iic (a c : ℝ) :
    ∫ z in Set.Iic a, Real.exp (c * z) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z
      = Real.exp (c^2 / 2) * Phi (a - c)
proof:
:= by
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic
        (fun z _ ↦ exp_mul_gaussianPDFReal_zero_one c z), integral_const_mul]
  congr 1
  have h_int_eq : ∫ z in Set.Iic a, gaussianPDFReal c 1 z
      = (gaussianReal c (1 : ℝ≥0) (Set.Iic a)).toReal :=
    setIntegral_gaussianPDFReal_eq_toReal measurableSet_Iic c
  have h_shift : gaussianReal c (1 : ℝ≥0) (Set.Iic a) =
                 gaussianReal 0 1 (Set.Iic (a - c)) := by
    have hmap : (gaussianReal (0 : ℝ) 1).map (fun y ↦ y + c) = gaussianReal c 1 := by
      rw [gaussianReal_map_add_const, zero_add]
    rw [← hmap, Measure.map_apply (by fun_prop) measurableSet_Iic]
    congr 1; ext y; simp [Set.mem_Iic, le_sub_iff_add_le, add_comm]
  rw [h_int_eq, h_shift]; rfl

name: max_put_payoff_eq_indicator
statement:
private lemma max_put_payoff_eq_indicator {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ}
    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (z : ℝ) :
    max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z) 0 =
      (Set.Iic (-bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)).indicator
        (fun z' ↦ K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z') z
proof:
:= by
  by_cases h : z ∈ Set.Iic (-bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem h]
    have hz_le : z ≤ -bsd2 S_0 K r σ T := h
    have hST_le : bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z ≤ K := by
      by_contra hcontra
      have h_gt : z > -bsd2 S_0 K r σ T :=
        (bsTerminal_gt_K_iff hS_0 hK hσ hT z).mp (not_le.mp hcontra)
      linarith
    exact max_eq_left (sub_nonneg.mpr hST_le)
  · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem h]
    have hz_gt : -bsd2 S_0 K r σ T < z := not_le.mp h
    have hST_gt : bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z > K :=
      (bsTerminal_gt_K_iff hS_0 hK hσ hT z).mpr hz_gt
    exact max_eq_right (sub_nonpos.mpr hST_gt.le)

name: bs_put_formula
statement:
theorem bs_put_formula {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) 0 ∂Q
      = K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (-(bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)) -
        S_0 * Phi (-(bsd1 S_0 K r σ T))
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨hS_0, hK, hσ, hT, hZ⟩ := h
  set d_1 : ℝ := bsd1 S_0 K r σ T with d_1_def
  set d_2 : ℝ := bsd2 S_0 K r σ T with d_2_def
  set μ_log : ℝ := (r - σ^2 / 2) * T
  set ν_log : ℝ := σ * Real.sqrt T with ν_log_def
  have hsqrT_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt T := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hT
  have hν_log_pos : 0 < ν_log := mul_pos hσ hsqrT_pos
  have hν_log_sq : ν_log^2 = σ^2 * T := by
    rw [ν_log_def, mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hT.le]
  have h_algebra : μ_log + ν_log^2 / 2 = r * T := by rw [hν_log_sq]; ring
  
  have h_shift_eq : (-d_2) - ν_log = -d_1 := by
    rw [d_1_def, d_2_def, bsd2]; ring
  have h_payoff_meas : Measurable fun z : ℝ ↦ max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z) 0 := by
    unfold bsTerminal; fun_prop
  
  rw [integral_const_mul]
  rw [show (fun ω ↦ max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) 0)
        = (fun z ↦ max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z) 0) ∘ Z from rfl,
      hZ.integral_comp h_payoff_meas.aestronglyMeasurable,
      integral_gaussianReal_eq_integral_smul (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0)]
  
  rw [show (fun z : ℝ ↦ gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z • max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z) 0)
        = (Set.Iic (-d_2)).indicator
            (fun z ↦ gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z * (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z)) from
      funext (fun z ↦ by
        rw [smul_eq_mul, max_put_payoff_eq_indicator hS_0 hK hσ hT z]
        by_cases hz : z ∈ Set.Iic (-d_2)
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_mem hz, Set.indicator_of_mem hz]
        · rw [Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, Set.indicator_of_notMem hz, mul_zero])]
  rw [integral_indicator measurableSet_Iic]
  
  have h_split_integrand : ∀ z : ℝ,
      gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z * (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T z)
        = K * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z
          - (S_0 * Real.exp μ_log) * (Real.exp (ν_log * z) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z) := by
    intro z
    unfold bsTerminal
    have h_exp : Real.exp ((r - σ^2 / 2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)
                = Real.exp μ_log * Real.exp (ν_log * z) := by
      show Real.exp ((r - σ^2 / 2) * T + σ * Real.sqrt T * z)
            = Real.exp ((r - σ^2 / 2) * T) * Real.exp (σ * Real.sqrt T * z)
      exact Real.exp_add _ _
    rw [h_exp]; ring
  rw [setIntegral_congr_fun measurableSet_Iic (fun z _ ↦ h_split_integrand z)]
  
  have h_int_pdf_Iic : IntegrableOn (gaussianPDFReal 0 1) (Set.Iic (-d_2)) volume :=
    (integrable_gaussianPDFReal 0 1).integrableOn
  have h_int_asset : IntegrableOn
      (fun z : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (ν_log * z) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z)
      (Set.Iic (-d_2)) volume := by
    refine ((integrable_gaussianPDFReal ν_log 1).const_mul
      (Real.exp (ν_log^2 / 2))).integrableOn.congr_fun ?_ measurableSet_Iic
    intro z _
    exact (exp_mul_gaussianPDFReal_zero_one ν_log z).symm
  
  rw [integral_sub (h_int_pdf_Iic.const_mul _) (h_int_asset.const_mul _)]
  rw [integral_const_mul, integral_const_mul]
  
  have h_pdf_int_eq :
      ∫ z in Set.Iic (-d_2), gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z = Phi (-d_2) := by
    rw [setIntegral_gaussianPDFReal_eq_toReal measurableSet_Iic (0 : ℝ),
        gaussianReal_Iic_toReal]
  rw [h_pdf_int_eq, integral_exp_mul_gaussianPDFReal_Iic, h_shift_eq]
  
  have h_exp_combine : Real.exp (-r * T) * Real.exp μ_log * Real.exp (ν_log^2 / 2) = 1 := by
    rw [mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, ← Real.exp_add,
        show -r * T + (μ_log + ν_log^2 / 2) = 0 from by rw [h_algebra]; ring]
    exact Real.exp_zero
  calc Real.exp (-r * T) *
        (K * Phi (-d_2) - S_0 * Real.exp μ_log * (Real.exp (ν_log^2 / 2) * Phi (-d_1)))
      = K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (-d_2) -
        (Real.exp (-r * T) * Real.exp μ_log * Real.exp (ν_log^2 / 2)) * (S_0 * Phi (-d_1)) := by
        ring
    _ = K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (-d_2) - 1 * (S_0 * Phi (-d_1)) := by rw [h_exp_combine]
    _ = K * Real.exp (-r * T) * Phi (-d_2) - S_0 * Phi (-d_1) := by rw [one_mul]

name: bs_put_call_parity
statement:
theorem bs_put_call_parity {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    (∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q)
      - (∫ ω, Real.exp (-r * T) * max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) 0 ∂Q)
      = S_0 - K * Real.exp (-r * T)
proof:
:= by
  rw [bs_call_formula h, bs_put_formula h]
  have h_d1 := Phi_add_Phi_neg (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T)
  have h_d2 := Phi_add_Phi_neg (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T)
  
  
  linear_combination S_0 * h_d1 - K * Real.exp (-r * T) * h_d2

name: reduces
statement:
theorem reduces to a one-liner.

## Map of consequences

| Theorem                            | Proof via                              |
|
| `bsV_le_S`                         | `Phi ≤ 1` + `Phi ≥ 0` (direct)         |
| `bsP_le_K_disc`                    | `Phi ≤ 1` + `Phi ≥ 0` (direct)         |
| `bsV_ge_forward_lower_bound`       | parity + `bsP_nonneg`                  |
| `bsP_ge_intrinsic_no_arb`          | parity + `bsV_nonneg`                  |
| `bsV_strict_gt_immediate_exercise` | forward lb + `exp(-rT) < 1` for `rT>0` |
| `box_spread_identity`              | subtract two parities                  |

The last is Merton (1973) — the strict bound that proves American = European
for a non-dividend call (early exercise is never optimal).

## Why this unification is the right one

Each of the six bounds in the table can be (and was) proved independently
from the BS formula by hand. But the *meaning* of each — bsV ≤ S says "a
call costs less than the stock", bsP ≥ K · e^{−rT} − S says "a put costs at
least the discounted strike minus spot", etc. — sits on the rectangle. Naming
the rectangle makes the meaning explicit and the proofs trivial.
-/

@[expose] public section

namespace MathFin

open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory Real

/-! ### Bridging the closed-form `bsV`/`bsP` definitions to integral forms -/

/
`∫ e^{−rT} · (S_T − K)⁺ dQ`. Pure normalisation of `bs_call_formula`
(reconciles `Real.exp (-r * T)` with `Real.exp (-(r * T))`). -/
private lemma bsV_eq_riskNeutralExpectation
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    bsV K r σ S_0 T =
      ∫ ω, Real.exp (-(r * T)) *
            max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  have h_form := bs_call_formula h
  have h_exp : Real.exp (-r * T) = Real.exp (-(r * T)) := by congr 1; ring
  rw [h_exp] at h_form
  
  
  show S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) -
        K * Real.exp (-(r * T)) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T) = _
  exact h_form.symm

name: bsV_eq_riskNeutralExpectation
statement:
private lemma bsV_eq_riskNeutralExpectation
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    bsV K r σ S_0 T =
      ∫ ω, Real.exp (-(r * T)) *
            max (bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω) - K) 0 ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  have h_form := bs_call_formula h
  have h_exp : Real.exp (-r * T) = Real.exp (-(r * T)) := by congr 1; ring
  rw [h_exp] at h_form
  
  
  show S_0 * Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) -
        K * Real.exp (-(r * T)) * Phi (bsd2 S_0 K r σ T) = _
  exact h_form.symm

name: bsP_eq_riskNeutralExpectation
statement:
private lemma bsP_eq_riskNeutralExpectation
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    bsP K r σ S_0 T =
      ∫ ω, Real.exp (-(r * T)) *
            max (K - bsTerminal S_0 r σ T (Z ω)) 0 ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  have h_form := bs_put_formula h
  have h_exp : Real.exp (-r * T) = Real.exp (-(r * T)) := by congr 1; ring
  rw [h_exp] at h_form
  show K * Real.exp (-(r * T)) * Phi (-bsd2 S_0 K r σ T) -
        S_0 * Phi (-bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) = _
  exact h_form.symm

name: bsV_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  rw [bsV_eq_riskNeutralExpectation h]
  exact integral_nonneg fun _ ↦
    mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (le_max_right _ _)

name: bsP_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  rw [bsP_eq_riskNeutralExpectation h]
  exact integral_nonneg fun _ ↦
    mul_nonneg (Real.exp_pos _).le (le_max_right _ _)

name: bsV_le_S
statement:
lemma bsV_le_S (K r σ : ℝ) (S τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    bsV K r σ S τ ≤ S
proof:
:= by
  unfold bsV
  have h_Φd1 : Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ) ≤ 1 := Phi_le_one _
  have h_Φd2 : 0 ≤ Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ) := Phi_nonneg _
  have h_exp : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h_S_term : S * Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ) ≤ S := by
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_Φd1 hS
    simpa using this
  have h_K_term : 0 ≤ K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ) := by
    positivity
  linarith

name: bsP_le_K_disc
statement:
lemma bsP_le_K_disc (K r σ : ℝ) (S τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 ≤ S) (hK : 0 ≤ K) :
    bsP K r σ S τ ≤ K * Real.exp (-(r * τ))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bsP
  have h_Φnegd2 : Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ) ≤ 1 := Phi_le_one _
  have h_Φnegd1 : 0 ≤ Phi (-bsd1 S K r σ τ) := Phi_nonneg _
  have h_exp : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h_first :
      K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (-bsd2 S K r σ τ) ≤
        K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := by
    have h_factor_nn : 0 ≤ K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := mul_nonneg hK h_exp
    have := mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h_Φnegd2 h_factor_nn
    simpa using this
  have h_second : 0 ≤ S * Phi (-bsd1 S K r σ τ) := mul_nonneg hS h_Φnegd1
  linarith

name: bsV_ge_forward_lower_bound
proof:
:= by
  have h_par := bsP_eq_bsV K r σ S_0 T
  have h_pos := bsP_nonneg h
  linarith

name: bsP_ge_intrinsic_no_arb
proof:
:= by
  have h_par := bsP_eq_bsV K r σ S_0 T
  have h_pos := bsV_nonneg h
  linarith

name: box_spread_identity
statement:
theorem box_spread_identity (K₁ K₂ r σ S τ : ℝ) :
    (bsV K₁ r σ S τ - bsP K₁ r σ S τ) -
        (bsV K₂ r σ S τ - bsP K₂ r σ S τ) =
      (K₂ - K₁) * Real.exp (-(r * τ))
proof:
:= by
  have h₁ : bsP K₁ r σ S τ = bsV K₁ r σ S τ - S + K₁ * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) :=
    bsP_eq_bsV K₁ r σ S τ
  have h₂ : bsP K₂ r σ S τ = bsV K₂ r σ S τ - S + K₂ * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) :=
    bsP_eq_bsV K₂ r σ S τ
  linarith

name: bsV_strict_gt_immediate_exercise
proof:
:= by
  have h_forward := bsV_ge_forward_lower_bound h
  have hT := h.T_pos
  have hK := h.K_pos
  have h_exp_lt_one : Real.exp (-(r * T)) < 1 := by
    rw [Real.exp_lt_one_iff]; linarith [mul_pos hr hT]
  have h_K_strict : K * Real.exp (-(r * T)) < K := by
    have := mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_exp_lt_one hK
    simpa using this
  linarith

name: noArbBox
statement:
theorem noArbBox
    {Ω : Type*} {mΩ : MeasurableSpace Ω}
    {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q]
    {S_0 K r σ T : ℝ} {Z : Ω → ℝ}
    (h : BSCallHyp Q S_0 K r σ T Z) :
    max 0 (S_0 - K * Real.exp (-(r * T))) ≤ bsV K r σ S_0 T ∧
    bsV K r σ S_0 T ≤ S_0 ∧
    max 0 (K * Real.exp (-(r * T)) - S_0) ≤ bsP K r σ S_0 T ∧
    bsP K r σ S_0 T ≤ K * Real.exp (-(r * T))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact max_le (bsV_nonneg h) (bsV_ge_forward_lower_bound h)
  · exact bsV_le_S K r σ S_0 T h.S_0_pos.le h.K_pos.le
  · exact max_le (bsP_nonneg h) (bsP_ge_intrinsic_no_arb h)
  · exact bsP_le_K_disc K r σ S_0 T h.S_0_pos.le h.K_pos.le

name: mertonVol_delta_zero
statement:
lemma mertonVol_delta_zero {σ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (T : ℝ) (n : ℕ) :
    mertonVol σ 0 T n = σ
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertonVol
  simp [Real.sqrt_sq hσ]

name: le_mertonVol
statement:
lemma le_mertonVol {σ T : ℝ} (δ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 ≤ σ) (hT : 0 < T) (n : ℕ) :
    σ ≤ mertonVol σ δ T n
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertonVol
  calc σ = Real.sqrt (σ ^ 2) := (Real.sqrt_sq hσ).symm
    _ ≤ _ := Real.sqrt_le_sqrt (le_add_of_nonneg_right
        (div_nonneg (by positivity) hT.le))

name: mertonCallTerm_delta_zero_le
statement:
lemma mertonCallTerm_delta_zero_le {S_0 K r σ T k : ℝ} (δ : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0)
    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hk : -1 < k)
    (n : ℕ) :
    mertonCallTerm S_0 K r σ T k 0 Λ n ≤ mertonCallTerm S_0 K r σ T k δ Λ n
proof:
:= by
  rw [mertonCallTerm_eq_bsV, mertonCallTerm_eq_bsV, mertonVol_delta_zero hσ.le]
  exact (bsV_strictMonoOn_sigma hK hT (mertonSpot_pos hS_0 hk Λ n)).monotoneOn
    (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr hσ) (Set.mem_Ioi.mpr (mertonVol_pos hσ hT n))
    (le_mertonVol δ hσ.le hT n)

name: mertonCallPrice_delta_zero_le
statement:
lemma mertonCallPrice_delta_zero_le {S_0 K r σ T k : ℝ} (δ : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0)
    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hk : -1 < k) :
    mertonCallPrice S_0 K r σ T k 0 Λ ≤ mertonCallPrice S_0 K r σ T k δ Λ
proof:
:= by
  unfold mertonCallPrice
  exact integral_mono (integrable_mertonCallTerm 0 Λ hS_0 hK hσ hT hk)
    (integrable_mertonCallTerm δ Λ hS_0 hK hσ hT hk)
    (mertonCallTerm_delta_zero_le δ Λ hS_0 hK hσ hT hk)

name: bsV_le_mertonCallPrice_delta_zero
statement:
lemma bsV_le_mertonCallPrice_delta_zero {S_0 K r σ T k : ℝ} (Λ : ℝ≥0)
    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hk : -1 < k) :
    bsV K r σ S_0 T ≤ mertonCallPrice S_0 K r σ T k 0 Λ
proof:
:= by
  have h_spot_int : Integrable (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ) (poissonMeasure Λ) :=
    integrable_mertonSpot Λ hS_0 hk
  
  have h_lin_int : Integrable
      (fun n ↦ Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) * (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n - S_0))
      (poissonMeasure Λ) :=
    (h_spot_int.sub (integrable_const _)).const_mul _
  have h_tan_int : Integrable (fun n ↦
      bsV K r σ S_0 T + Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) * (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n - S_0))
      (poissonMeasure Λ) :=
    (integrable_const _).add h_lin_int
  
  have h_tan_le : ∀ n, bsV K r σ S_0 T
      + Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) * (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n - S_0)
      ≤ mertonCallTerm S_0 K r σ T k 0 Λ n := fun n ↦ by
    rw [mertonCallTerm_eq_bsV, mertonVol_delta_zero hσ.le]
    exact bsV_spot_tangent_le hK hσ hT hS_0 (mertonSpot_pos hS_0 hk Λ n)
  
  have h_tan_integral : ∫ n, (bsV K r σ S_0 T
      + Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) * (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n - S_0))
      ∂(poissonMeasure Λ) = bsV K r σ S_0 T := by
    rw [integral_add (integrable_const _) h_lin_int,
      integral_const_mul, integral_sub h_spot_int (integrable_const _),
      integral_mertonSpot, integral_const, integral_const, probReal_univ,
      one_smul, one_smul, sub_self, mul_zero, add_zero]
  calc bsV K r σ S_0 T
      = ∫ n, (bsV K r σ S_0 T
          + Phi (bsd1 S_0 K r σ T) * (mertonSpot S_0 k Λ n - S_0))
          ∂(poissonMeasure Λ) := h_tan_integral.symm
    _ ≤ ∫ n, mertonCallTerm S_0 K r σ T k 0 Λ n ∂(poissonMeasure Λ) :=
        integral_mono h_tan_int
          (integrable_mertonCallTerm 0 Λ hS_0 hK hσ hT hk) h_tan_le
    _ = mertonCallPrice S_0 K r σ T k 0 Λ := rfl

name: bsV_le_mertonCallPrice
statement:
theorem bsV_le_mertonCallPrice {S_0 K r σ T k : ℝ} (δ : ℝ) (Λ : ℝ≥0)
    (hS_0 : 0 < S_0) (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hT : 0 < T) (hk : -1 < k) :
    bsV K r σ S_0 T ≤ mertonCallPrice S_0 K r σ T k δ Λ
proof:
:=
  (bsV_le_mertonCallPrice_delta_zero Λ hS_0 hK hσ hT hk).trans
    (mertonCallPrice_delta_zero_le δ Λ hS_0 hK hσ hT hk)

name: bsV_gamma_pos
statement:
theorem bsV_gamma_pos {K r σ : ℝ} (_hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    0 < gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) / (S * σ * Real.sqrt τ)
proof:
:= by
  have h_pdf_pos : 0 < gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) :=
    gaussianPDFReal_pos 0 1 _ (one_ne_zero : (1 : ℝ≥0) ≠ 0)
  have h_den_pos : 0 < S * σ * Real.sqrt τ :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos hS hσ) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ)
  exact div_pos h_pdf_pos h_den_pos

name: bsV_rho_nonneg
statement:
theorem bsV_rho_nonneg {K τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 ≤ K) (hτ : 0 ≤ τ) (S r σ : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ K * τ * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)
proof:
:= by
  have h_exp_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h_Phi_nn : 0 ≤ Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ) := Phi_nonneg _
  exact mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg (mul_nonneg hK hτ) h_exp_nn) h_Phi_nn

name: bsV_partial_K_nonpos
statement:
theorem bsV_partial_K_nonpos (S K r σ τ : ℝ) :
    -(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)) ≤ 0
proof:
:= by
  have h_exp_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h_Phi_nn : 0 ≤ Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ) := Phi_nonneg _
  have := mul_nonneg h_exp_nn h_Phi_nn
  linarith

name: bsV_partial_KK_nonneg
statement:
theorem bsV_partial_KK_nonneg {K σ τ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ)
    (S r : ℝ) :
    0 ≤ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) /
          (K * σ * Real.sqrt τ)
proof:
:= by
  have h_exp_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) := (Real.exp_pos _).le
  have h_pdf_nn : 0 ≤ gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) :=
    gaussianPDFReal_nonneg _ _ _
  have h_num_nn : 0 ≤ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) :=
    mul_nonneg h_exp_nn h_pdf_nn
  have h_den_pos : 0 < K * σ * Real.sqrt τ :=
    mul_pos (mul_pos hK hσ) (Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ)
  exact div_nonneg h_num_nn h_den_pos.le

name: hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_S
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_S {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ bsCashDigital K r σ s τ)
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) / (S * σ * Real.sqrt τ)) S
proof:
:= by
  have h_d2_S := hasDerivAt_bsd2_S (r := r) hK hσ hτ hS
  have h_Phi_d2 := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp S h_d2_S
  have h := h_Phi_d2.const_mul (Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
  unfold bsCashDigital
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl

name: hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_S
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_S {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ bsAssetDigital K r σ s τ)
      (Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ) + gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) / (σ * Real.sqrt τ)) S
proof:
:= by
  have h_sqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have hS_ne : S ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
  have h_d1_S := hasDerivAt_bsd1_S (r := r) hK hσ hτ hS
  have h_Phi_d1 := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ)).comp S h_d1_S
  have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ s) 1 S := hasDerivAt_id S
  have h := h_id.mul h_Phi_d1
  unfold bsAssetDigital
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  field_simp

name: hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_SS
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_SS {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun s ↦ Phi (bsd1 s K r σ τ) +
        gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 s K r σ τ) / (σ * Real.sqrt τ))
      (-(gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) *
        bsd2 S K r σ τ / (S * σ ^ 2 * τ))) S
proof:
:= by
  have h_sqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have hS_ne : S ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
  have h_sqrt_sq : Real.sqrt τ ^ 2 = τ := Real.sq_sqrt hτ.le
  have h_d1_S := hasDerivAt_bsd1_S (r := r) hK hσ hτ hS
  
  have h_Phi := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ)).comp S h_d1_S
  
  have h_pdf := (hasDerivAt_gaussianPDFReal_zero_one (bsd1 S K r σ τ)).comp S h_d1_S
  
  have h_pdf_div := h_pdf.div_const (σ * Real.sqrt τ)
  have h_full := h_Phi.add h_pdf_div
  convert h_full using 1 <;> try rfl
  rw [show bsd2 S K r σ τ = bsd1 S K r σ τ - σ * Real.sqrt τ from by rw [bsd2]]
  field_simp
  rw [show Real.sqrt τ ^ 2 = τ from h_sqrt_sq]
  ring

name: hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_tau
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_tau (S K r σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ bsAssetDigital K r σ S t)
      (S * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd1 S K r σ τ) *
        (((r + σ^2/2) * τ - Real.log (S/K)) / (2 * σ * τ * Real.sqrt τ))) τ
proof:
:= by
  have h_d1_τ := hasDerivAt_bsd1_tau S K r σ hσ hτ
  have h_Phi := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ)).comp τ h_d1_τ
  have h := h_Phi.const_mul S

name: hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_tau
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_tau (S K r σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ bsCashDigital K r σ S t)
      (-r * Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ) +
        Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) *
          (((r + σ^2/2) * τ - Real.log (S/K)) / (2 * σ * τ * Real.sqrt τ)
            - σ / (2 * Real.sqrt τ))) τ
proof:
:= by
  have h_d2_τ := hasDerivAt_bsd2_tau S K r σ hσ hτ
  have h_Phi := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp τ h_d2_τ
  have h_neg : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ -(r * t)) (-r) τ := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_id τ).const_mul r
    convert h.neg using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring
  have h_exp : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (-(r * t)))
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * (-r)) τ := h_neg.exp
  have h := h_exp.mul h_Phi
  unfold bsCashDigital
  convert h using 1 <;> try rfl
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  ring

statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsAssetDigital_sigma (S K r : ℝ) {σ τ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :

  have h_sqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have h_sqrt_sq : Real.sqrt τ ^ 2 = τ := Real.sq_sqrt hτ.le
  have h_d1_σ := hasDerivAt_bsd1_sigma S K r hσ hτ
  have h_Phi := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd1 S K r σ τ)).comp σ h_d1_σ
  have h := h_Phi.const_mul S

name: hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_sigma

lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_sigma (S K : ℝ) {r σ τ : ℝ} (hσ : 0 < σ) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun σ' ↦ bsCashDigital K r σ' S τ)
      (-(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) *
        bsd1 S K r σ τ / σ)) σ
proof:
:= by
  have h_sqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have h_sqrt_sq : Real.sqrt τ ^ 2 = τ := Real.sq_sqrt hτ.le
  have h_d2_σ := hasDerivAt_bsd2_sigma S K r hσ hτ
  have h_Phi := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp σ h_d2_σ
  have h := h_Phi.const_mul (Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
  unfold bsCashDigital

name: hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_r
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_r (S K σ : ℝ) (hσ : 0 < σ) {τ : ℝ} (hτ : 0 < τ) (r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦ bsCashDigital K r' σ S τ)
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) *
        (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) * (Real.sqrt τ / σ)
          - τ * Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ))) r
proof:
:= by
  have h_d2_r := hasDerivAt_bsd2_r S K σ τ hσ hτ r
  have h_Phi := (hasDerivAt_Phi (bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp r h_d2_r
  have h_neg_r : HasDerivAt (fun r' : ℝ ↦ -(r' * τ)) (-τ) r := by
    have h := (hasDerivAt_id r).mul_const τ
    convert h.neg using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring
  have h_exp : HasDerivAt (fun r' : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (-(r' * τ)))
      (Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * (-τ)) r := h_neg_r.exp
  have h := h_exp.mul h_Phi
  unfold bsCashDigital

name: hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_SS
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bsCashDigital_SS {K r σ : ℝ} (hK : 0 < K) (hσ : 0 < σ)
    {S τ : ℝ} (hS : 0 < S) (hτ : 0 < τ) :
    HasDerivAt
      (fun s ↦ Real.exp (-(r * τ)) *
        gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 s K r σ τ) / (s * σ * Real.sqrt τ))
      (-(Real.exp (-(r * τ)) * gaussianPDFReal 0 1 (bsd2 S K r σ τ) *
        bsd1 S K r σ τ / (S ^ 2 * σ ^ 2 * τ))) S
proof:
:= by
  have h_sqrt_pos : 0 < Real.sqrt τ := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hτ
  have h_sqrt_ne : Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 := h_sqrt_pos.ne'
  have hσ_ne : σ ≠ 0 := hσ.ne'
  have hS_ne : S ≠ 0 := hS.ne'
  have h_sqrt_sq : Real.sqrt τ ^ 2 = τ := Real.sq_sqrt hτ.le
  have h_denom_ne : S * σ * Real.sqrt τ ≠ 0 :=
    mul_ne_zero (mul_ne_zero hS_ne hσ_ne) h_sqrt_ne
  have h_d2_S := hasDerivAt_bsd2_S (r := r) hK hσ hτ hS
  have h_pdf := (hasDerivAt_gaussianPDFReal_zero_one (bsd2 S K r σ τ)).comp S h_d2_S
  
  have h_num := h_pdf.const_mul (Real.exp (-(r * τ)))
  
  have h_id : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ s) 1 S := hasDerivAt_id S
  have h_denom : HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ ↦ s * σ * Real.sqrt τ) (σ * Real.sqrt τ) S := by
    have h := (h_id.mul_const σ).mul_const (Real.sqrt τ)
    convert h using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring
  have h_div := h_num.div h_denom h_denom_ne
  convert h_div using 1
  all_goals try rfl
  have h_bsd1 : bsd1 S K r σ τ = bsd2 S K r σ τ + σ * Real.sqrt τ := by
    rw [bsd2]; ring
  rw [h_bsd1]
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  field_simp
  rw [show Real.sqrt τ ^ 2 = τ from h_sqrt_sq]
  ring

name: log_div_mul_exp_neg
statement:
lemma log_div_mul_exp_neg (S K r τ : ℝ) (hS : 0 < S) (hK : 0 < K) :
    Real.log (S / (K * Real.exp (-(r * τ)))) = Real.log (S / K) + r * τ
proof:
:= by
  have hexp_ne : Real.exp (-(r * τ)) ≠ 0 := (Real.exp_pos _).ne'
  rw [Real.log_div hS.ne' (mul_ne_zero hK.ne' hexp_ne)]
  rw [Real.log_mul hK.ne' hexp_ne]
  rw [Real.log_exp]
  rw [Real.log_div hS.ne' hK.ne']
  ring
