  have h0 : (0 : ℝ) = ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, (0 : ℝ) * ((unifPart T n (k + 1) : ℝ) - unifPart T n k) := by
    simp only [zero_mul, Finset.sum_const_zero]
  rw [h0]
  exact tendsto_finsetSum _ fun k _ ↦
    (tendsto_clampM_sub_sq_integral (memLp_eval hB (unifPart T n k))).mul_const _

name: eval_zero_ae
statement: lemma eval_zero_ae (hBmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) : B 0 =ᵐ[μ] 0
proof:
:= by
  have hint : ∫ ω, (B 0 ω) ^ 2 ∂μ = 0 := by rw [integral_eval_sq hB hBmeas 0]; simp
  have hsq : (fun ω ↦ (B 0 ω) ^ 2) =ᵐ[μ] 0 :=
    (integral_eq_zero_iff_of_nonneg_ae (ae_of_all _ fun ω ↦ sq_nonneg _)
      (memLp_eval hB 0).integrable_sq).mp hint
  filter_upwards [hsq] with ω hω
  exact pow_eq_zero_iff two_ne_zero |>.mp hω

name: memLp_halfD
statement:
lemma memLp_halfD (hBmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (fun ω ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B T ω ^ 2 - B 0 ω ^ 2 - (T : ℝ))) 2 μ
proof:
:= by
  refine (memLp_congr_ae ?_).mp
    (MemLp.const_mul (memLp_increment_sq_centered_two hB 0 T (T : ℝ)) (1 / 2))
  filter_upwards [eval_zero_ae hB hBmeas] with ω hω
  simp only [Pi.zero_apply] at hω
  rw [hω]; ring

name: lp_dist_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [lp_two_norm_sq]
  refine integral_congr_ae ?_
  filter_upwards [Lp.coeFn_sub (hf.toLp f) (hg.toLp g), hf.coeFn_toLp, hg.coeFn_toLp]
    with z h1 h2 h3
  rw [h1]; simp only [Pi.sub_apply]; rw [h2, h3]

name: tendsto_norm_toLp_sub
statement:
lemma tendsto_norm_toLp_sub {F G : ℕ → Ω → ℝ} (hF : ∀ n, MemLp (F n) 2 μ)
    (hG : ∀ n, MemLp (G n) 2 μ)
    (h : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ ω, (F n ω - G n ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0)) :
    Tendsto (fun n ↦ ‖(hF n).toLp (F n) - (hG n).toLp (G n)‖) atTop (𝓝 0)
proof:
:= by
  have heq : (fun n ↦ ‖(hF n).toLp (F n) - (hG n).toLp (G n)‖)
      = fun n ↦ Real.sqrt (∫ ω, (F n ω - G n ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) := by
    funext n; rw [← lp_dist_sq (hF n) (hG n), Real.sqrt_sq (norm_nonneg _)]
  rw [heq]
  simpa only [Function.comp_def, Real.sqrt_zero] using (Real.continuous_sqrt.tendsto 0).comp h

name: itoIntegralCLM_T_brownian
statement:
theorem itoIntegralCLM_T_brownian (hBmeas : ∀ t, Measurable (B t)) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ gB : Lp ℝ 2 (trimMeasure_T (μ := μ) T hBmeas),
      itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas gB
        = (memLp_halfD hB hBmeas T).toLp (fun ω ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B T ω ^ 2 - B 0 ω ^ 2 - (T : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  set c := (memLp_halfD hB hBmeas T).toLp
    (fun ω ↦ (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B T ω ^ 2 - B 0 ω ^ 2 - (T : ℝ))) with hc
  
  have hMex : ∀ n, ∃ m, ∫ ω, (truncRiemannFn hBmeas T n m ω - riemannFn hBmeas T n ω) ^ 2 ∂μ
      < 1 / (n + 1) := fun n ↦
    ((tendsto_integral_truncRiemann_sub_sq hB hBmeas T n).eventually_lt_const (by positivity)).exists
  choose M hM using hMex
  
  have herr : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ ω,
      (truncRiemannFn hBmeas T n (M n) ω - riemannFn hBmeas T n ω) ^ 2 ∂μ) atTop (𝓝 0) :=
    squeeze_zero (fun n ↦ integral_nonneg fun ω ↦ sq_nonneg _) (fun n ↦ (hM n).le)
      tendsto_one_div_add_atTop_nhds_zero_nat
  
  have hrito : Tendsto (fun n ↦ ∫ ω,
      (riemannFn hBmeas T n ω - (1 / 2 : ℝ) * (B T ω ^ 2 - B 0 ω ^ 2 - (T : ℝ))) ^ 2 ∂μ)
      atTop (𝓝 0) := by
    have key := itoSquared_L2_tendsto_div2 hB hBmeas T
    simpa only [riemannFn] using key
  
  have hA : Tendsto (fun n ↦ (memLp_truncRiemannFn hB hBmeas T n (M n)).toLp
      (truncRiemannFn hBmeas T n (M n))) atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    have hb1 := tendsto_norm_toLp_sub (fun n ↦ memLp_truncRiemannFn hB hBmeas T n (M n))
      (fun n ↦ memLp_riemannFn hB hBmeas T n) herr
    have hb2 := tendsto_norm_toLp_sub (fun n ↦ memLp_riemannFn hB hBmeas T n)
      (fun _ ↦ memLp_halfD hB hBmeas T) hrito
    rw [tendsto_iff_norm_sub_tendsto_zero]
    refine squeeze_zero (fun n ↦ norm_nonneg _) (fun n ↦ ?_) (by simpa using hb1.add hb2)
    calc ‖(memLp_truncRiemannFn hB hBmeas T n (M n)).toLp (truncRiemannFn hBmeas T n (M n)) - c‖
        = dist ((memLp_truncRiemannFn hB hBmeas T n (M n)).toLp (truncRiemannFn hBmeas T n (M n))) c :=
          (dist_eq_norm _ _).symm
      _ ≤ dist ((memLp_truncRiemannFn hB hBmeas T n (M n)).toLp (truncRiemannFn hBmeas T n (M n)))
            ((memLp_riemannFn hB hBmeas T n).toLp (riemannFn hBmeas T n))
          + dist ((memLp_riemannFn hB hBmeas T n).toLp (riemannFn hBmeas T n)) c :=
          dist_triangle _ _ _
      _ = _ := by rw [dist_eq_norm, dist_eq_norm, hc]; simp only [one_div]
  
  have hisom : Isometry (itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas) :=
    AddMonoidHomClass.isometry_of_norm _ (itoIntegralCLM_T_norm hB T hBmeas)
  set x : ℕ → Lp ℝ 2 (trimMeasure_T (μ := μ) T hBmeas) :=
    fun n ↦ simpleAssembly_T (μ := μ) T hBmeas (truncStep hBmeas T n (M n)) with hxdef
  have hax : ∀ n, itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas (x n)
      = (memLp_truncRiemannFn hB hBmeas T n (M n)).toLp (truncRiemannFn hBmeas T n (M n)) :=
    fun n ↦ itoIntegralCLM_T_truncStep hB hBmeas T n (M n)
  have hxCauchy : CauchySeq x := by
    have haC : CauchySeq (fun n ↦ itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas (x n)) := by
      simp only [hax]; exact hA.cauchySeq
    rw [Metric.cauchySeq_iff] at haC ⊢
    intro ε hε
    obtain ⟨N, hN⟩ := haC ε hε
    exact ⟨N, fun mm hmm nn hnn ↦ by rw [← hisom.dist_eq]; exact hN mm hmm nn hnn⟩
  obtain ⟨gB, hgB⟩ := cauchySeq_tendsto_of_complete hxCauchy
  refine ⟨gB, ?_⟩
  have h1 : Tendsto (fun n ↦ itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas (x n)) atTop
      (𝓝 (itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas gB)) :=
    ((itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas).continuous.tendsto gB).comp hgB
  have h2 : Tendsto (fun n ↦ itoIntegralCLM_T hB T hBmeas (x n)) atTop (𝓝 c) := by
    simp only [hax]; exact hA
  exact tendsto_nhds_unique h1 h2

name: gmMeasure_apply
statement:
theorem gmMeasure_apply (θ p : ℝ) (s : Set (Fin 6)) :
    gmMeasure θ p s
      = ∑ i, Set.indicator s (fun j => ENNReal.ofReal (gmWeight θ p j)) i
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure, Measure.sum_apply _ MeasurableSet.of_discrete, tsum_fintype]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
  rw [Measure.smul_apply, Measure.dirac_apply' i MeasurableSet.of_discrete, smul_eq_mul]
  by_cases h : i ∈ s <;> simp [h]

name: gmWeight_nonneg
statement:
theorem gmWeight_nonneg {θ p : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 ≤ θ) (hθ1 : θ ≤ 1) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    ∀ i, 0 ≤ gmWeight θ p i
proof:
:= by
  intro i; fin_cases i <;> simp [gmWeight] <;> nlinarith

name: gmMeasure_eq_ofReal
statement:
theorem gmMeasure_eq_ofReal {θ p : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gmWeight θ p i) (s : Set (Fin 6)) :
    gmMeasure θ p s = ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i, Set.indicator s (gmWeight θ p) i)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_apply, ENNReal.ofReal_sum_of_nonneg]
  · refine Finset.sum_congr rfl fun i _ => ?_
    by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;> simp [hi]
  · intro i _; by_cases hi : i ∈ s <;> simp [hi, hnn i]

name: gmMeasure_univ_eq_one
statement: theorem gmMeasure_univ_eq_one : gmMeasure θ p Set.univ = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn, show (1 : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal 1 by simp]
  congr 1
  simp [gmWeight, Fin.sum_univ_six]; ring

name: gmMeasure_high_eq
statement: theorem gmMeasure_high_eq : gmMeasure θ p gmHigh = ENNReal.ofReal θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn]; congr 1
  simp [gmHigh, gmWeight, Fin.sum_univ_six]; ring

name: gmMeasure_high_compl_eq
statement: theorem gmMeasure_high_compl_eq : gmMeasure θ p gmHighᶜ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn]; congr 1
  simp [gmHigh, gmWeight, Fin.sum_univ_six]; ring

name: gmMeasure_high_inter_inf
statement:
theorem gmMeasure_high_inter_inf (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) :
    gmMeasure θ p (gmHigh ∩ gmInformed) = ENNReal.ofReal p * ENNReal.ofReal θ
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp0]; congr 1
  simp [gmHigh, gmInformed, gmWeight, Fin.sum_univ_six]; ring

name: gmMeasure_low_inter_inf
statement:
theorem gmMeasure_low_inter_inf (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) :
    gmMeasure θ p (gmHighᶜ ∩ gmInformed) = ENNReal.ofReal p * ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp0]; congr 1
  simp [gmHigh, gmInformed, gmWeight, Fin.sum_univ_six]; ring

name: gmMeasure_uninformed_high
statement:
theorem gmMeasure_uninformed_high :
    2 * gmMeasure θ p ((gmHigh ∩ gmBuy) \ gmInformed) = gmMeasure θ p (gmHigh \ gmInformed)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn, gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn,
    show (2 : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal 2 by simp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
  congr 1
  simp [gmHigh, gmBuy, gmInformed, gmWeight, Fin.sum_univ_six]; ring

name: gmMeasure_uninformed_low
statement:
theorem gmMeasure_uninformed_low :
    2 * gmMeasure θ p ((gmHighᶜ ∩ gmBuy) \ gmInformed) = gmMeasure θ p (gmHighᶜ \ gmInformed)
proof:
:= by
  rw [gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn, gmMeasure_eq_ofReal hnn,
    show (2 : ℝ≥0∞) = ENNReal.ofReal 2 by simp, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul (by norm_num)]
  congr 1
  simp [gmHigh, gmBuy, gmInformed, gmWeight, Fin.sum_univ_six]; ring

name: gm_buy_inter_inf
statement: theorem gm_buy_inter_inf : gmBuy ∩ gmInformed = gmHigh ∩ gmInformed
proof:
:= by
  ext i; fin_cases i <;> simp [gmBuy, gmInformed, gmHigh]

name: gmMeasure_isProbabilityMeasure
statement:
theorem gmMeasure_isProbabilityMeasure {θ p : ℝ} (hnn : ∀ i, 0 ≤ gmWeight θ p i) :
    IsProbabilityMeasure (gmMeasure θ p)
proof:
:=
  ⟨gmMeasure_univ_eq_one hnn⟩

name: spread_pos_witness
statement:
theorem spread_pos_witness {θ p VL VH : ℝ}
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hV : VL < VH) :
    0 < (∫ ω, payoff gmHigh VL VH ω ∂((gmMeasure θ p)[|gmBuy]))
      - (∫ ω, payoff gmHigh VL VH ω ∂((gmMeasure θ p)[|gmBuyᶜ]))
proof:
:= by
  have hnn := gmWeight_nonneg hθ0.le hθ1.le hp0.le hp1
  haveI := gmMeasure_isProbabilityMeasure hnn
  exact spread_pos_of_model (gmMeasure θ p) gmHigh gmBuy gmInformed
    MeasurableSet.of_discrete MeasurableSet.of_discrete MeasurableSet.of_discrete
    hθ0 hθ1 hp0 hV (gmMeasure_high_eq hnn) gm_buy_inter_inf
    (gmMeasure_high_inter_inf hnn hp0.le) (gmMeasure_low_inter_inf hnn hp0.le)
    (gmMeasure_uninformed_high hnn) (gmMeasure_uninformed_low hnn)

name: inter_informed
statement:
theorem inter_informed (H B I : Set Ω) (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I) :
    H ∩ B ∩ I = H ∩ I
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.inter_assoc, hbuy, ← Set.inter_assoc, Set.inter_self]

name: inter_informed_low
statement:
theorem inter_informed_low (H B I : Set Ω) (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I) :
    Hᶜ ∩ B ∩ I = ∅
proof:
:= by
  rw [Set.inter_assoc, hbuy, ← Set.inter_assoc, Set.compl_inter_self, Set.empty_inter]

name: two_mul_inter_high_buy
statement:
theorem two_mul_inter_high_buy (H B I : Set Ω) (hI : MeasurableSet I) {θ p : ℝ≥0∞}
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I)
    (hindep : μ (H ∩ I) = p * θ)
    (hH : μ H = θ)
    (huninf : 2 * μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) = μ (H \ I)) :
    2 * μ (H ∩ B) = (1 + p) * θ
proof:
:= by
  have hsplitB : μ (H ∩ B ∩ I) + μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) = μ (H ∩ B) :=
    measure_inter_add_sdiff (H ∩ B) hI
  have hsplitH : μ (H ∩ I) + μ (H \ I) = μ H := measure_inter_add_sdiff H hI
  calc 2 * μ (H ∩ B)
      = 2 * μ (H ∩ B ∩ I) + 2 * μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) := by rw [← hsplitB, mul_add]
    _ = 2 * μ (H ∩ I) + μ (H \ I) := by rw [inter_informed H B I hbuy, huninf]
    _ = μ (H ∩ I) + (μ (H ∩ I) + μ (H \ I)) := by rw [two_mul, add_assoc]
    _ = p * θ + θ := by rw [hsplitH, hindep, hH]
    _ = (1 + p) * θ := by rw [add_mul, one_mul, add_comm]

name: two_mul_cond_buy_high
statement:
theorem two_mul_cond_buy_high (H B I : Set Ω) (hH' : MeasurableSet H) (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    {θ p : ℝ≥0∞} (hθ0 : θ ≠ 0) (hθtop : θ ≠ ∞)
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I) (hindep : μ (H ∩ I) = p * θ) (hH : μ H = θ)
    (huninf : 2 * μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) = μ (H \ I)) :
    2 * μ[B | H] = 1 + p
proof:
:= by
  have h2 : 2 * μ (H ∩ B) = (1 + p) * θ :=
    two_mul_inter_high_buy μ H B I hI hbuy hindep hH huninf
  calc 2 * μ[B | H]
      = 2 * (θ⁻¹ * μ (H ∩ B)) := by rw [cond_apply hH', hH]
    _ = θ⁻¹ * (2 * μ (H ∩ B)) := by rw [mul_left_comm]
    _ = θ⁻¹ * ((1 + p) * θ) := by rw [h2]
    _ = 1 + p := by
        rw [mul_comm (1 + p) θ, ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hθ0 hθtop, one_mul]

name: two_mul_cond_buy_low_add
statement:
theorem two_mul_cond_buy_low_add (H B I : Set Ω) (hHc : MeasurableSet Hᶜ)
    (hI : MeasurableSet I) {θ' p : ℝ≥0∞} (hθ0 : θ' ≠ 0) (hθtop : θ' ≠ ∞)
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I)
    (hindep : μ (Hᶜ ∩ I) = p * θ')
    (hHc' : μ Hᶜ = θ')
    (huninf : 2 * μ ((Hᶜ ∩ B) \ I) = μ (Hᶜ \ I)) :
    2 * μ[B | Hᶜ] + p = 1
proof:
:= by
  have hz : μ (Hᶜ ∩ B ∩ I) = 0 := by
    rw [inter_informed_low H B I hbuy]; exact measure_empty
  have hsplitB : μ (Hᶜ ∩ B ∩ I) + μ ((Hᶜ ∩ B) \ I) = μ (Hᶜ ∩ B) :=
    measure_inter_add_sdiff (Hᶜ ∩ B) hI
  have hBmass : 2 * μ (Hᶜ ∩ B) = μ (Hᶜ \ I) := by
    rw [← hsplitB, hz, zero_add]; exact huninf
  have hsplitH : μ (Hᶜ ∩ I) + μ (Hᶜ \ I) = μ Hᶜ := measure_inter_add_sdiff Hᶜ hI
  have hp : p = θ'⁻¹ * (p * θ') := by
    rw [mul_comm p θ', ← mul_assoc, ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hθ0 hθtop, one_mul]
  calc 2 * μ[B | Hᶜ] + p
      = 2 * (θ'⁻¹ * μ (Hᶜ ∩ B)) + p := by rw [cond_apply hHc, hHc']
    _ = θ'⁻¹ * (2 * μ (Hᶜ ∩ B)) + p := by rw [mul_left_comm]
    _ = θ'⁻¹ * μ (Hᶜ \ I) + θ'⁻¹ * μ (Hᶜ ∩ I) := by rw [hBmass, hindep, ← hp]
    _ = θ'⁻¹ * (μ (Hᶜ ∩ I) + μ (Hᶜ \ I)) := by rw [← mul_add, add_comm]
    _ = θ'⁻¹ * θ' := by rw [hsplitH, hHc']
    _ = 1 := ENNReal.inv_mul_cancel hθ0 hθtop

name: integral_payoff
statement:
theorem integral_payoff (ν : Measure Ω) [IsProbabilityMeasure ν] (H : Set Ω)
    (hH : MeasurableSet H) (VL VH : ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂ν = VL + (ν H).toReal * (VH - VL)
proof:
:= by
  unfold payoff
  rw [integral_add (integrable_const VL) ((integrable_const (VH - VL)).indicator hH),
    integral_const, integral_indicator_const _ hH]
  simp [measureReal_def]

name: integral_payoff_cond
statement:
theorem integral_payoff_cond [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (E H : Set Ω) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    (hE0 : μ E ≠ 0) (VL VH : ℝ) :
    ∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|E]) = VL + (μ[H | E]).toReal * (VH - VL)
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ[|E]) := cond_isProbabilityMeasure hE0
  exact integral_payoff (μ[|E]) H hH VL VH

name: spread_eq
statement:
theorem spread_eq [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (B S H : Set Ω) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    (hB0 : μ B ≠ 0) (hS0 : μ S ≠ 0) (VL VH : ℝ) :
    (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|B])) - (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|S]))
      = (VH - VL) * ((μ[H | B]).toReal - (μ[H | S]).toReal)
proof:
:= by
  rw [integral_payoff_cond μ B H hH hB0 VL VH, integral_payoff_cond μ S H hH hS0 VL VH]
  ring

name: quote_eq_zero_of_null
statement:
theorem quote_eq_zero_of_null (H B : Set Ω) (VL VH : ℝ) (hB : μ B = 0) :
    ∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|B]) = 0
proof:
:= by
  rw [cond_eq_zero_of_meas_eq_zero hB]; simp

name: buy_denom_pos
statement:
theorem buy_denom_pos {θ p : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    0 < 1 + p * (2 * θ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp1.lt_or_eq with h | h
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp0 hθ0.le]
  · subst h; linarith

name: sell_denom_pos
statement:
theorem sell_denom_pos {θ p : ℝ} (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    0 < 1 - p * (2 * θ - 1)
proof:
:= by
  rcases hp1.lt_or_eq with h | h
  · nlinarith [mul_nonneg hp0 (sub_pos.mpr hθ1).le]
  · subst h; linarith

name: post_sub_post
statement:
theorem post_sub_post {θ p : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p)
    (hp1 : p ≤ 1) :
    postBuy θ p - postSell θ p
      = 4 * p * θ * (1 - θ) / (1 - p ^ 2 * (2 * θ - 1) ^ 2)
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := (buy_denom_pos hθ0 hp0.le hp1).ne'
  have h2 := (sell_denom_pos hθ1 hp0.le hp1).ne'
  have h3 : (1 : ℝ) - p ^ 2 * (2 * θ - 1) ^ 2
      = (1 + p * (2 * θ - 1)) * (1 - p * (2 * θ - 1)) := by ring
  have hD : (1 : ℝ) - p ^ 2 * (2 * θ - 1) ^ 2 ≠ 0 := by rw [h3]; exact mul_ne_zero h1 h2
  unfold postBuy postSell
  rw [div_sub_div _ _ h1 h2, div_eq_div_iff (mul_ne_zero h1 h2) hD]
  ring

name: postSell_lt_postBuy
statement:
theorem postSell_lt_postBuy {θ p : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p)
    (hp1 : p ≤ 1) : postSell θ p < postBuy θ p
proof:
:= by
  have h1 := buy_denom_pos hθ0 hp0.le hp1
  have h2 := sell_denom_pos hθ1 hp0.le hp1
  have hdiff : 0 < postBuy θ p - postSell θ p := by
    rw [post_sub_post hθ0 hθ1 hp0 hp1]
    apply div_pos
    · nlinarith [mul_pos (mul_pos hp0 hθ0) (sub_pos.mpr hθ1)]
    · nlinarith
  linarith

name: spread_pos
statement:
theorem spread_pos {θ p VL VH : ℝ} (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p)
    (hp1 : p ≤ 1) (hV : VL < VH) :
    0 < (VH - VL) * (postBuy θ p - postSell θ p)
proof:
:=
  mul_pos (sub_pos.mpr hV) (sub_pos.mpr (postSell_lt_postBuy hθ0 hθ1 hp0 hp1))

name: postSell_one_one
statement: theorem postSell_one_one : postSell 1 1 = 0
proof: := by unfold postSell; norm_num

name: postBuy_one_one
statement: theorem postBuy_one_one : postBuy 1 1 = 1
proof: := by unfold postBuy; norm_num

name: spread_junk_at_corner
statement:
theorem spread_junk_at_corner (VL VH : ℝ) :
    (VH - VL) * (postBuy 1 1 - postSell 1 1) = VH - VL
proof:
:= by
  rw [postSell_one_one, postBuy_one_one]; ring

name: measure_toReal_of_likelihoods
statement:
theorem measure_toReal_of_likelihoods [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (E H : Set Ω) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    {a c t : ℝ} (ha : (μ[E | H]).toReal = a) (hc : (μ[E | Hᶜ]).toReal = c)
    (ht : (μ H).toReal = t) :
    (μ E).toReal = a * t + c * (1 - t)
proof:
:= by
  have hcompl : (μ Hᶜ).toReal = 1 - t := by
    rw [← measureReal_def, probReal_compl_eq_one_sub hH, measureReal_def, ht]
  have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal (cond_add_cond_compl_eq (μ := μ) (t := E) hH)
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (measure_ne_top _ E) (measure_ne_top _ _))
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (measure_ne_top _ E) (measure_ne_top _ _)),
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ha, hc, ht, hcompl] at h
  exact h.symm

name: cond_toReal_eq
statement:
theorem cond_toReal_eq [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (E H : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    {a c t : ℝ} (ha : (μ[E | H]).toReal = a) (hc : (μ[E | Hᶜ]).toReal = c)
    (ht : (μ H).toReal = t) :
    (μ[H | E]).toReal = a * t / (a * t + c * (1 - t))
proof:
:= by
  rw [cond_eq_inv_mul_cond_mul hE hH μ, ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_mul,
    ENNReal.toReal_inv, measure_toReal_of_likelihoods μ E H hH ha hc ht, ha, ht,
    div_eq_inv_mul]
  ring

name: cond_compl_toReal
statement:
theorem cond_compl_toReal [IsFiniteMeasure μ] (E F : Set Ω) (hE : MeasurableSet E)
    (hF0 : μ F ≠ 0) :
    (μ[Eᶜ | F]).toReal = 1 - (μ[E | F]).toReal
proof:
:= by
  haveI : IsProbabilityMeasure (μ[|F]) := cond_isProbabilityMeasure hF0
  rw [← measureReal_def, probReal_compl_eq_one_sub hE, measureReal_def]

name: cond_buy_high_toReal
statement:
theorem cond_buy_high_toReal (H B : Set Ω) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p)
    (hhigh : 2 * μ[B | H] = 1 + ENNReal.ofReal p) :
    (μ[B | H]).toReal = (1 + p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hhigh
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_add ENNReal.one_ne_top ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
    ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp0] at h
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ENNReal.toReal_one] at h
  linarith

name: cond_buy_low_toReal
statement:
theorem cond_buy_low_toReal (H B : Set Ω) {p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p)
    (hlow : 2 * μ[B | Hᶜ] + ENNReal.ofReal p = 1) :
    (μ[B | Hᶜ]).toReal = (1 - p) / 2
proof:
:= by
  have h := congrArg ENNReal.toReal hlow
  rw [ENNReal.toReal_add
      (ENNReal.mul_ne_top (by simp) (measure_ne_top _ B)) ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top,
    ENNReal.toReal_mul, ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hp0] at h
  simp only [ENNReal.toReal_ofNat, ENNReal.toReal_one] at h
  linarith

name: postBuy_eq
statement:
theorem postBuy_eq [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (H B : Set Ω) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    {θ p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (ht : (μ H).toReal = θ)
    (hhigh : 2 * μ[B | H] = 1 + ENNReal.ofReal p)
    (hlow : 2 * μ[B | Hᶜ] + ENNReal.ofReal p = 1) :
    (μ[H | B]).toReal = postBuy θ p
proof:
:= by
  rw [cond_toReal_eq μ B H hB hH (cond_buy_high_toReal μ H B hp0 hhigh)
      (cond_buy_low_toReal μ H B hp0 hlow) ht, postBuy,
    show (1 + p) / 2 * θ + (1 - p) / 2 * (1 - θ) = (1 + p * (2 * θ - 1)) / 2 by ring,
    show (1 + p) / 2 * θ = (1 + p) * θ / 2 by ring]
  exact div_div_div_cancel_right₀ two_ne_zero _ _

name: postSell_eq
statement:
theorem postSell_eq [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (H B : Set Ω) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hH : MeasurableSet H)
    {θ p : ℝ} (hp0 : 0 ≤ p) (ht : (μ H).toReal = θ) (hHc0 : μ Hᶜ ≠ 0)
    (hhigh : 2 * μ[B | H] = 1 + ENNReal.ofReal p)
    (hlow : 2 * μ[B | Hᶜ] + ENNReal.ofReal p = 1) :
    (μ[H | Bᶜ]).toReal = postSell θ p
proof:
:= by
  have hH0 : μ H ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    have hz : (0 : ℝ≥0∞) = 1 + ENNReal.ofReal p := by
      rw [← hhigh, cond_eq_zero_of_meas_eq_zero h]; simp
    exact absurd hz.symm (by simp)
  have hsa : (μ[Bᶜ | H]).toReal = (1 - p) / 2 := by
    rw [cond_compl_toReal μ B H hB hH0, cond_buy_high_toReal μ H B hp0 hhigh]; ring
  have hsc : (μ[Bᶜ | Hᶜ]).toReal = (1 + p) / 2 := by
    rw [cond_compl_toReal μ B Hᶜ hB hHc0, cond_buy_low_toReal μ H B hp0 hlow]; ring
  rw [cond_toReal_eq μ Bᶜ H hB.compl hH hsa hsc ht, postSell,
    show (1 - p) / 2 * θ + (1 + p) / 2 * (1 - θ) = (1 - p * (2 * θ - 1)) / 2 by ring,
    show (1 - p) / 2 * θ = (1 - p) * θ / 2 by ring]
  exact div_div_div_cancel_right₀ two_ne_zero _ _

name: spread_pos_of_model
statement:
theorem spread_pos_of_model [IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (H B I : Set Ω)
    (hH : MeasurableSet H) (hB : MeasurableSet B) (hI : MeasurableSet I)
    {θ p VL VH : ℝ}
    (hθ0 : 0 < θ) (hθ1 : θ < 1) (hp0 : 0 < p) (hV : VL < VH)
    (hprior : μ H = ENNReal.ofReal θ)
    (hbuy : B ∩ I = H ∩ I)
    (hindepH : μ (H ∩ I) = ENNReal.ofReal p * ENNReal.ofReal θ)
    (hindepHc : μ (Hᶜ ∩ I) = ENNReal.ofReal p * ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ))
    (huninfH : 2 * μ ((H ∩ B) \ I) = μ (H \ I))
    (huninfHc : 2 * μ ((Hᶜ ∩ B) \ I) = μ (Hᶜ \ I)) :
    0 < (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|B])) - (∫ ω, payoff H VL VH ω ∂(μ[|Bᶜ]))
proof:
:= by
  have hθ0' : (0:ℝ) ≤ θ := hθ0.le
  
  have hp1 : p ≤ 1 := by
    have h := measure_mono (μ := μ) (Set.inter_subset_left (s := H) (t := I))
    rw [hindepH, hprior, ← ENNReal.ofReal_mul hp0.le,
      ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal_iff hθ0'] at h
    nlinarith
  have hoθ0 : ENNReal.ofReal θ ≠ 0 := by rw [Ne, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]; linarith
  have hoθc0 : ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) ≠ 0 := by rw [Ne, ENNReal.ofReal_eq_zero]; linarith
  have hpriorc : μ Hᶜ = ENNReal.ofReal (1 - θ) := by
    rw [prob_compl_eq_one_sub hH, hprior, ENNReal.ofReal_sub 1 hθ0', ENNReal.ofReal_one]
  have ht : (μ H).toReal = θ := by rw [hprior]; exact ENNReal.toReal_ofReal hθ0'
  have hH0 : μ H ≠ 0 := by rw [hprior]; exact hoθ0
  have hHc0 : μ Hᶜ ≠ 0 := by rw [hpriorc]; exact hoθc0
  
  have hhigh : 2 * μ[B | H] = 1 + ENNReal.ofReal p :=
    two_mul_cond_buy_high μ H B I hH hI hoθ0
      ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hbuy hindepH hprior huninfH
  have hlow : 2 * μ[B | Hᶜ] + ENNReal.ofReal p = 1 :=
    two_mul_cond_buy_low_add μ H B I hH.compl hI hoθc0
      ENNReal.ofReal_ne_top hbuy hindepHc hpriorc huninfHc
  
  have ha := cond_buy_high_toReal μ H B hp0.le hhigh
  have hc := cond_buy_low_toReal μ H B hp0.le hlow
  have hsa : (μ[Bᶜ | H]).toReal = (1 - p) / 2 := by
    rw [cond_compl_toReal μ B H hB hH0, ha]; ring
  have hsc : (μ[Bᶜ | Hᶜ]).toReal = (1 + p) / 2 := by
    rw [cond_compl_toReal μ B Hᶜ hB hHc0, hc]; ring
  have hBreal : (μ B).toReal = (1 + p * (2 * θ - 1)) / 2 := by
    rw [measure_toReal_of_likelihoods μ B H hH ha hc ht]; ring
  have hBcreal : (μ Bᶜ).toReal = (1 - p * (2 * θ - 1)) / 2 := by
    rw [measure_toReal_of_likelihoods μ Bᶜ H hH hsa hsc ht]; ring
  have hB0 : μ B ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hBreal
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hBreal
    linarith [buy_denom_pos hθ0 hp0.le hp1]
  have hBc0 : μ Bᶜ ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    rw [h] at hBcreal
    simp only [ENNReal.toReal_zero] at hBcreal
    linarith [sell_denom_pos hθ1 hp0.le hp1]
  
  rw [spread_eq μ B Bᶜ H hH hB0 hBc0 VL VH,
    postBuy_eq μ H B hB hH hp0.le ht hhigh hlow,
    postSell_eq μ H B hB hH hp0.le ht hHc0 hhigh hlow]
  exact spread_pos hθ0 hθ1 hp0 hp1 hV

name: vasicekSDE_variance_pos
statement:
lemma vasicekSDE_variance_pos (σ κ t : ℝ)
    (hκ : 0 < κ) (ht : 0 < t) (hσ : σ ≠ 0) :
    0 < vasicekSDEVariance σ κ t
proof:
:= by
  unfold vasicekSDEVariance
  have h_κt_pos : 0 < 2 * κ * t := by positivity
  have h_exp_lt : Real.exp (-(2 * κ * t)) < 1 := by

name: hasDerivAt_modifiedNumerator
statement:
theorem hasDerivAt_modifiedNumerator
    (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → ℕ) (c : ι → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 + y ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y' ↦ modifiedNumerator s t c y')
               (-convexityNumerator s t c y) y
proof:
:= by
  unfold modifiedNumerator convexityNumerator
  rw [show -∑ i ∈ s, (t i : ℝ) * ((t i : ℝ) + 1) * c i / (1 + y) ^ (t i + 2) =
      ∑ i ∈ s, (-((t i : ℝ) * ((t i : ℝ) + 1) * c i / (1 + y) ^ (t i + 2))) from by
    rw [← Finset.sum_neg_distrib]]
  apply HasDerivAt.fun_sum
  intros i _
  have h_term : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℝ ↦ c i / (1 + y') ^ (t i + 1))
                (-(((t i + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * c i / (1 + y) ^ (t i + 1 + 1))) y :=
    hasDerivAt_coupon_term (c i) (t i + 1) hy
  have h_pulled := h_term.const_mul ((t i : ℝ))
  have h_func :
      (fun y' : ℝ ↦ (t i : ℝ) * (c i / (1 + y') ^ (t i + 1))) =
      (fun y' : ℝ ↦ (t i : ℝ) * c i / (1 + y') ^ (t i + 1)) := by
    funext y'; ring
  rw [h_func] at h_pulled
  convert h_pulled using 1 <;> try rfl
  push_cast
  have : t i + 1 + 1 = t i + 2 := by omega
  rw [this]
  ring

name: hasDerivAt_bondPriceDisc_secondDeriv

    (s : Finset ι) (t : ι → ℕ) (c : ι → ℝ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 + y ≠ 0) :

      P'' / bondPriceDisc s t c y =

name: firstToDefault_spread_eq_sum_hazards
statement:
theorem firstToDefault_spread_eq_sum_hazards

    (hindep : iIndepFun τ μ)

name: hasDerivAt_coupon_term
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_coupon_term (c_val : ℝ) (n : ℕ) {y : ℝ} (hy : 1 + y ≠ 0) :
    HasDerivAt (fun y' ↦ c_val / (1 + y') ^ n)
               (-((n : ℝ) * c_val / (1 + y) ^ (n + 1))) y
proof:
:= by
  have h_base : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℝ ↦ (1 : ℝ) + y') 1 y :=
    (hasDerivAt_id y).const_add 1
  have h_pow : HasDerivAt (fun y' : ℝ ↦ (1 + y') ^ n)
               ((n : ℝ) * (1 + y) ^ (n - 1) * 1) y := h_base.pow n
  have h_pow_ne : (1 + y) ^ n ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hy
  have h_const : HasDerivAt (fun _ : ℝ ↦ c_val) 0 y := hasDerivAt_const y c_val
  have h_div := h_const.div h_pow h_pow_ne
  rw [show (-((n : ℝ) * c_val / (1 + y) ^ (n + 1)))
        = (0 * (1 + y) ^ n - c_val * ((n : ℝ) * (1 + y) ^ (n - 1) * 1)) / ((1 + y) ^ n) ^ 2 from by
      cases n with
      | zero => simp
      | succ m =>
        simp only [Nat.add_sub_cancel]
        have h_pow_m_ne : (1 + y) ^ m ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero _ hy
        field_simp
        ring]
  exact h_div

name: vasicekKernel_memLp
statement:
lemma vasicekKernel_memLp (κ : ℝ) (hκ : 0 ≤ κ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (vasicekKernel κ T) 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (memLp_top_of_bound (by unfold vasicekKernel; fun_prop) 1 ?_).mono_exponent le_top
  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mpr (ae_of_all _ ?_)
  intro s hs
  rw [vasicekKernel, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (Real.exp_pos _)]
  refine Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr ?_
  have hTs : 0 ≤ (T : ℝ) - s := by linarith [hs.2]
  nlinarith [mul_nonneg hκ hTs]

name: vasicekKernel_integral_sq
statement:
lemma vasicekKernel_integral_sq (κ : ℝ) (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∫ s in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ), (vasicekKernel κ T s) ^ 2 ∂volume
      = (1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ * T))) / (2 * κ)
proof:
:= by
  have hsq : ∀ s : ℝ, (vasicekKernel κ T s) ^ 2 = Real.exp (-(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - s))) := by
    intro s
    rw [vasicekKernel, sq, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ))]
  rw [show (fun s ↦ (vasicekKernel κ T s) ^ 2)
        = (fun s ↦ Real.exp (-(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - s)))) from funext hsq]
  have hderiv : ∀ s ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ Real.exp (-(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - s))) / (2 * κ))
        (Real.exp (-(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - s)))) s := by
    intro s _
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ -(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - s)))
        (2 * κ) s := by
      have : HasDerivAt (fun s ↦ -(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - s)))
          (-(2 * κ * (-1))) s := by
        apply HasDerivAt.neg
        apply HasDerivAt.const_mul
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id s).const_sub (T : ℝ)
      simpa using this
    have h2 := (Real.hasDerivAt_exp _).comp s h1
    have h3 := h2.div_const (2 * κ)
    rwa [mul_div_assoc, div_self (mul_ne_zero two_ne_zero hκ), mul_one] at h3
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv
    (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; fun_prop)]
  simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero]
  rw [show (2 : ℝ) * κ * ((T : ℝ) - 0) = 2 * κ * T by ring]
  ring

name: vasicekShortRate_hasLaw_gaussian
statement:
theorem vasicekShortRate_hasLaw_gaussian (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ)
    (r₀ θ σ : ℝ) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    HasLaw (fun ω ↦ vasicekSDEMean r₀ θ κ (T : ℝ)
        + σ * (wienerIntegralLp B hB T (vasicekKernelLp κ hκ.le T) ω))
      (gaussianReal (vasicekSDEMean r₀ θ κ (T : ℝ)) (vasicekSDEVariance σ κ (T : ℝ)).toNNReal) μ
proof:
:= by
  
  have hW : HasLaw (fun ω ↦ wienerIntegralLp B hB T (vasicekKernelLp κ hκ.le T) ω)
      (gaussianReal 0 (∫ s in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
        (vasicekKernelLp κ hκ.le T s) ^ 2 ∂volume).toNNReal) μ :=
    wienerIntegralLp_hasLaw_gaussian hB T _
  
  have hInt : (∫ s in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ), (vasicekKernelLp κ hκ.le T s) ^ 2 ∂volume)
      = (1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ * T))) / (2 * κ) := by
    rw [show (∫ s in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ), (vasicekKernelLp κ hκ.le T s) ^ 2 ∂volume)
          = ∫ s in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ), (vasicekKernel κ T s) ^ 2 ∂volume by
        refine integral_congr_ae ?_
        filter_upwards [(vasicekKernel_memLp κ hκ.le T).coeFn_toLp] with s hs
        rw [vasicekKernelLp, hs]]
    exact vasicekKernel_integral_sq κ hκ.ne' T
  rw [hInt] at hW
  
  have hexp_le : Real.exp (-(2 * κ * (T : ℝ))) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [hκ.le, NNReal.coe_nonneg T])
  have hden : (0 : ℝ) < 2 * κ := by linarith
  have hkernel_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (1 - Real.exp (-(2 * κ * (T : ℝ)))) / (2 * κ) :=
    div_nonneg (by linarith) hden.le
  have hvar_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ vasicekSDEVariance σ κ (T : ℝ) := by
    unfold vasicekSDEVariance
    exact div_nonneg (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg σ) (by linarith)) hden.le
  have hShift := gaussianReal_const_add (gaussianReal_const_mul hW σ)
    (vasicekSDEMean r₀ θ κ (T : ℝ))
  convert hShift using 2
  · ring
  · refine NNReal.coe_injective ?_
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ hvar_nonneg, NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_mk,
      Real.coe_toNNReal _ hkernel_nonneg]
    unfold vasicekSDEVariance
    ring

name: hazardSurvival_at_zero
statement: lemma hazardSurvival_at_zero (h : ℝ → ℝ) : hazardSurvival h 0 = 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold hazardSurvival survivalFromIntensity cumulativeIntensity

name: hazardSurvival_pos
statement: lemma hazardSurvival_pos (h : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ) : 0 < hazardSurvival h t
proof:
:=

name: hasDerivAt_bondPortfolioDur_r
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bondPortfolioDur_r
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w T : ι → ℝ) (t r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦ bondPortfolioDur s w T t r')
      (-bondPortfolioConv s w T t r) r
proof:
:= by
  unfold bondPortfolioDur bondPortfolioConv
  have h_each : ∀ i ∈ s, HasDerivAt
      (fun r' ↦ w i * (T i - t) * Real.exp (-(r' * (T i - t))))
      (-(w i * (T i - t) ^ 2 * Real.exp (-(r * (T i - t))))) r := by
    intro i _
    
    
    have h := (hasDerivAt_zcb_r t (T i) r).const_mul (w i * (T i - t))
    simp only [zcb] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring
  have h_raw := HasDerivAt.fun_sum h_each
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h_raw
  exact h_raw

name: vasicekDeterministic_solves_ODE
statement:
theorem vasicekDeterministic_solves_ODE (r₀ θ κ t : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (vasicekDeterministic r₀ θ κ)
      (κ * (θ - vasicekDeterministic r₀ θ κ t)) t
proof:
:= by
  unfold vasicekDeterministic
  have h_neg_kt : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ -(κ * t)) (-κ) t := by
    have h_kt : HasDerivAt (fun t : ℝ ↦ κ * t) κ t := by
      have := (hasDerivAt_id t).const_mul κ
      simpa using this
    exact h_kt.neg
  have h_exp : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ Real.exp (-(κ * t)))
                (Real.exp (-(κ * t)) * (-κ)) t := h_neg_kt.exp
  have h_mul : HasDerivAt (fun t ↦ (r₀ - θ) * Real.exp (-(κ * t)))
                ((r₀ - θ) * (Real.exp (-(κ * t)) * (-κ))) t :=
    h_exp.const_mul (r₀ - θ)
  have h := h_mul.const_add θ
  convert h using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring

name: vasicekDeterministic_tendsto_mean

proof:
:= by
  have h1 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ κ * t) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop :=
    Filter.Tendsto.const_mul_atTop hκ Filter.tendsto_id
  have h2 : Filter.Tendsto (fun t : ℝ ↦ Real.exp (-(κ * t)))
      Filter.atTop (nhds 0) :=
    Real.tendsto_exp_neg_atTop_nhds_zero.comp h1
  unfold vasicekDeterministic
  simpa using (h2.const_mul (r₀ - θ)).const_add θ

name: vasicekDeterministic_at_halfLife
statement:

      (r₀ - θ) / 2
proof:

  unfold vasicekDeterministic meanReversionHalfLife
  have hκ_ne : κ ≠ 0 := hκ.ne'
  have h_inner : κ * (Real.log 2 / κ) = Real.log 2 := by field_simp
  have h_exp : Real.exp (-(κ * (Real.log 2 / κ))) = 1 / 2 := by
    rw [h_inner, Real.exp_neg, Real.exp_log (by norm_num : (0:ℝ) < 2)]
    norm_num
  rw [h_exp]
  ring

theorem forwardMeasure_isProbabilityMeasure {Q : Measure Ω} [IsProbabilityMeasure Q] (r T : ℝ) :

proof:

name: forwardMeasure_price
statement:
theorem forwardMeasure_price {Q : Measure Ω} (X : Ω → ℝ) (r T : ℝ) :
    Real.exp (-(r * T)) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂(forwardMeasure Q r T)
      = ∫ ω, Real.exp (-(r * T)) * X ω ∂Q
proof:
:= by
  have h := changeOfNumeraire (Q := Q) (BT := fun _ ↦ Real.exp (r * T))
    (NT := fun _ ↦ (1 : ℝ)) (B0 := (1 : ℝ)) (N0 := Real.exp (-(r * T))) X
    measurable_const measurable_const (fun _ ↦ one_pos) (fun _ ↦ Real.exp_pos _)
    (by norm_num) (Real.exp_pos _)
  simp only [div_one, one_mul] at h
  rw [forwardMeasure, h]
  refine integral_congr_ae (Filter.Eventually.of_forall fun ω ↦ ?_)
  show X ω / Real.exp (r * T) = Real.exp (-(r * T)) * X ω
  rw [div_eq_mul_inv, ← Real.exp_neg, mul_comm]

name: forwardMeasure_expected_spot
statement:
theorem forwardMeasure_expected_spot {Q : Measure Ω} (S_0 r T : ℝ) (X : Ω → ℝ)

    ∫ ω, X ω ∂(forwardMeasure Q r T) = S_0 * Real.exp (r * T)
proof:
:= by
  have hp := forwardMeasure_price (Q := Q) X r T
  rw [hEMM] at hp
  have key : ∫ ω, X ω ∂(forwardMeasure Q r T)
      = Real.exp (r * T) * (Real.exp (-(r * T)) * ∫ ω, X ω ∂(forwardMeasure Q r T)) := by
    rw [← mul_assoc, ← Real.exp_add, show r * T + -(r * T) = 0 from by ring, Real.exp_zero, one_mul]
  rw [key, hp, mul_comm]

name: vasicekIntegratedKernel_memLp
statement:
lemma vasicekIntegratedKernel_memLp {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    MemLp (vasicekIntegratedKernel κ T) 2 (volume.restrict (Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ)))
proof:
:= by
  refine (memLp_top_of_bound (by unfold vasicekIntegratedKernel; fun_prop) (1 / κ) ?_).mono_exponent
    le_top
  refine (ae_restrict_iff' measurableSet_Ioc).mpr (ae_of_all _ ?_)
  intro s hs
  rw [vasicekIntegratedKernel, Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have hexp_pos : 0 < Real.exp (-(κ * ((T : ℝ) - s))) := Real.exp_pos _
  have hTs : 0 ≤ (T : ℝ) - s := by linarith [hs.2]
  have hexp_le : Real.exp (-(κ * ((T : ℝ) - s))) ≤ 1 :=
    Real.exp_le_one_iff.mpr (by nlinarith [mul_nonneg hκ.le hTs])
  rw [abs_of_nonneg (div_nonneg (by linarith) hκ.le)]
  exact (div_le_div_iff_of_pos_right hκ).mpr (by linarith)

name: vasicekIntegratedKernel_integral_sq
statement:
lemma vasicekIntegratedKernel_integral_sq {κ : ℝ} (hκ : κ ≠ 0) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∫ u in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ), (vasicekIntegratedKernel κ T u) ^ 2 ∂volume
      = vasicekBondV κ (T : ℝ)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← intervalIntegral.integral_of_le (by positivity : (0 : ℝ) ≤ (T : ℝ))]
  have hderiv : ∀ u ∈ Set.uIcc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ),
      HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ ↦ u / κ ^ 2 - 2 * Real.exp (-(κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) / κ ^ 3
          + Real.exp (-(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) / (2 * κ ^ 3))
        ((vasicekIntegratedKernel κ T u) ^ 2) u := by
    intro u _
    have he : Real.exp (-(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - u)))
        = Real.exp (-(κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) * Real.exp (-(κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) := by
      rw [← Real.exp_add]; congr 1; ring
    have hlin : HasDerivAt (fun u : ℝ ↦ u / κ ^ 2) (1 / κ ^ 2) u :=
      (hasDerivAt_id u).div_const (κ ^ 2)
    have harg1 : HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ -(κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) κ u := by
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ -(κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) (-(κ * (-1))) u := by
        apply HasDerivAt.neg; apply HasDerivAt.const_mul
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_sub (T : ℝ)
      simpa using h
    have harg2 : HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ -(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) (2 * κ) u := by
      have h : HasDerivAt (fun u ↦ -(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) (-(2 * κ * (-1))) u := by
        apply HasDerivAt.neg; apply HasDerivAt.const_mul
        simpa using (hasDerivAt_id u).const_sub (T : ℝ)
      simpa using h
    have hexp1 := harg1.exp
    have hexp2 := harg2.exp
    have h2 := (hexp1.const_mul (2 : ℝ)).div_const (κ ^ 3)
    have h3 := hexp2.div_const (2 * κ ^ 3)
    have hcomb := (hlin.sub h2).add h3
    have hval : (1 / κ ^ 2 - 2 * (Real.exp (-(κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) * κ) / κ ^ 3
          + Real.exp (-(2 * κ * ((T : ℝ) - u))) * (2 * κ) / (2 * κ ^ 3))
        = (vasicekIntegratedKernel κ T u) ^ 2 := by
      rw [vasicekIntegratedKernel, he]; field_simp; ring
    exact hval ▸ hcomb
  rw [intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt hderiv
    (by apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable; unfold vasicekIntegratedKernel; fun_prop)]
  simp only [sub_self, mul_zero, neg_zero, Real.exp_zero, mul_one, sub_zero, zero_div]
  rw [vasicekBondV]
  field_simp
  ring

name: vasicekIntegratedKernelLp_integral_sq
proof:
:= by
  rw [show (∫ u in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ), (vasicekIntegratedKernelLp hκ T u) ^ 2 ∂volume)
        = ∫ u in Set.Ioc (0 : ℝ) (T : ℝ), (vasicekIntegratedKernel κ T u) ^ 2 ∂volume by
      refine integral_congr_ae ?_
      filter_upwards [(vasicekIntegratedKernel_memLp hκ T).coeFn_toLp] with u hu
      rw [vasicekIntegratedKernelLp, hu]]
  exact vasicekIntegratedKernel_integral_sq hκ.ne' T

name: vasicekIntegratedRate_hasLaw_gaussian
statement:
theorem vasicekIntegratedRate_hasLaw_gaussian (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ)
    (r₀ θ σ : ℝ) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    HasLaw (vasicekIntegratedRate hB r₀ θ σ hκ T)
      (gaussianReal (vasicekIntegratedMean r₀ θ κ (T : ℝ))
        (σ ^ 2 * vasicekBondV κ (T : ℝ)).toNNReal) μ
proof:
:= by
  have hW := vasicekWienerLaw hB hκ T
  have hV_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ vasicekBondV κ (T : ℝ) := vasicekBondV_nonneg hκ T
  have hShift := gaussianReal_const_add (gaussianReal_const_mul hW σ)
    (vasicekIntegratedMean r₀ θ κ (T : ℝ))
  convert hShift using 2
  · rfl
  · ring
  · refine NNReal.coe_injective ?_
    rw [Real.coe_toNNReal _ (mul_nonneg (sq_nonneg σ) hV_nonneg), NNReal.coe_mul, NNReal.coe_mk,
      Real.coe_toNNReal _ hV_nonneg]

name: vasicekBondPrice_eq
statement:
theorem vasicekBondPrice_eq (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ)
    (r₀ θ σ : ℝ) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-(vasicekIntegratedRate hB r₀ θ σ hκ T ω)) ∂μ
      = Real.exp (-(vasicekIntegratedMean r₀ θ κ (T : ℝ)) + σ ^ 2 * vasicekBondV κ (T : ℝ) / 2)
proof:
:= by
  set M : ℝ := vasicekIntegratedMean r₀ θ κ (T : ℝ) with hM
  set V : ℝ := vasicekBondV κ (T : ℝ) with hV
  have hV_nonneg : (0 : ℝ) ≤ V := hV ▸ vasicekBondV_nonneg hκ T
  have hW : HasLaw (fun ω ↦ wienerIntegralLp B hB T (vasicekIntegratedKernelLp hκ T) ω)
      (gaussianReal 0 V.toNNReal) μ := hV ▸ vasicekWienerLaw hB hκ T
  
  have hfactor : ∀ ω, Real.exp (-(vasicekIntegratedRate hB r₀ θ σ hκ T ω))
      = Real.exp (-M) * Real.exp ((-σ) *
          (wienerIntegralLp B hB T (vasicekIntegratedKernelLp hκ T) ω)) := by
    intro ω
    rw [vasicekIntegratedRate, ← hM, ← Real.exp_add]
    congr 1
    ring
  simp_rw [hfactor]
  rw [integral_const_mul,
    show (fun ω ↦ Real.exp ((-σ) * (wienerIntegralLp B hB T (vasicekIntegratedKernelLp hκ T) ω)))
        = (fun x ↦ Real.exp ((-σ) * x))
          ∘ (fun ω ↦ wienerIntegralLp B hB T (vasicekIntegratedKernelLp hκ T) ω) from rfl,
    hW.integral_comp (by fun_prop : AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x ↦ Real.exp ((-σ) * x))
      (gaussianReal 0 V.toNNReal)),
    integral_exp_mul_gaussianReal_zero (-σ) V.toNNReal,
    Real.coe_toNNReal _ hV_nonneg, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: vasicekBondPrice_affine
statement:
theorem vasicekBondPrice_affine (hB : IsPreBrownianReal B μ)
    (r₀ θ σ : ℝ) {κ : ℝ} (hκ : 0 < κ) (T : ℝ≥0) :
    ∫ ω, Real.exp (-(vasicekIntegratedRate hB r₀ θ σ hκ T ω)) ∂μ
      = vasicekBondA θ σ κ (T : ℝ) * Real.exp (-(vasicekBondB κ (T : ℝ) * r₀))
proof:
:= by
  rw [vasicekBondPrice_eq hB r₀ θ σ hκ T, vasicekBondA, vasicekIntegratedMean, ← Real.exp_add]
  congr 1
  ring

name: hasDerivAt_zcb_r_r
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_zcb_r_r (t T : ℝ) (r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦ -(T - t) * zcb r' t T) ((T - t)^2 * zcb r t T) r
proof:
:= by
  have h := (hasDerivAt_zcb_r t T r).const_mul (-(T - t))
  rw [show (T - t) ^ 2 * zcb r t T = -(T - t) * (-(T - t) * zcb r t T) from by ring]
  exact h

name: zcb_convexity_eq_time_to_maturity_sq
statement:
lemma zcb_convexity_eq_time_to_maturity_sq (t T r : ℝ) :
    ((T - t)^2 * zcb r t T) / zcb r t T = (T - t)^2
proof:
:= by
  have h_ne : zcb r t T ≠ 0 := (zcb_pos r t T).ne'
  field_simp

name: cdsFairSpread_TV_cash_flow_balance
statement:
theorem cdsFairSpread_TV_cash_flow_balance
    (c R annuity losses : ℝ) (h_annuity_ne : annuity ≠ 0) :
    c * annuity = (1 - R) * losses ↔ c = (1 - R) * losses / annuity
proof:
:= by
  rw [eq_div_iff h_annuity_ne]

name: survival_product_eq_exp_sum
statement:
theorem survival_product_eq_exp_sum (n : ℕ) (h Δt : Fin n → ℝ) :
    (∏ i, Real.exp (-(h i * Δt i))) = Real.exp (-(∑ i, h i * Δt i))
proof:
:= by
  rw [← Real.exp_sum]
  congr 1
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib]

name: kmvDistanceToDefault_eq_bsd2
statement:
theorem kmvDistanceToDefault_eq_bsd2 (V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ) (hV : 0 < V_0) (hF : 0 < F) :
    kmvDistanceToDefault V_0 F r σ_V T = bsd2 V_0 F r σ_V T
proof:
:= by
  unfold kmvDistanceToDefault
  rw [bsd2_eq_gbsd2_standard V_0 F r σ_V T hV hF]

name: kmvPD_nonneg
statement: lemma kmvPD_nonneg (V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ) : 0 ≤ kmvPD V_0 F r σ_V T
proof:
:=
  Phi_nonneg _

name: kmvPD_le_one
statement: lemma kmvPD_le_one (V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ) : kmvPD V_0 F r σ_V T ≤ 1
proof:
:=
  Phi_le_one _

name: kmv_survival_eq_Phi_d2
statement:
theorem kmv_survival_eq_Phi_d2 (V_0 F r σ_V T : ℝ) :
    1 - kmvPD V_0 F r σ_V T = Phi (kmvDistanceToDefault V_0 F r σ_V T)
proof:
:= by
  unfold kmvPD
  have := Phi_add_Phi_neg (kmvDistanceToDefault V_0 F r σ_V T)
  linarith

name: annuityValue_closed_form
statement:
lemma annuityValue_closed_form (n : ℕ) (c r Δt : ℝ)
    (h : Real.exp (-(r * Δt)) ≠ 1) :
    annuityValue n c r Δt =
      c * Real.exp (-(r * Δt)) *
        (1 - Real.exp (-(r * Δt)) ^ n) / (1 - Real.exp (-(r * Δt)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold annuityValue
  
  have h_term : ∀ i ∈ Finset.range n,
      c * Real.exp (-(r * ((↑i + 1) * Δt))) =
        c * Real.exp (-(r * Δt)) * Real.exp (-(r * Δt)) ^ i := by
    intro i _
    rw [show -(r * ((↑i + 1) * Δt)) = -(r * Δt) + ↑i * (-(r * Δt)) from by ring]
    rw [Real.exp_add, Real.exp_nat_mul]
    ring
  rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl h_term]
  rw [← Finset.mul_sum]
  rw [geom_sum_eq h n]
  have h_one_minus_ne : 1 - Real.exp (-(r * Δt)) ≠ 0 :=
    sub_ne_zero.mpr (Ne.symm h)
  have h_x_minus_one_ne : Real.exp (-(r * Δt)) - 1 ≠ 0 := sub_ne_zero.mpr h
  field_simp
  ring

name: hasDerivAt_neg_log_zcb_T
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_neg_log_zcb_T (r t T : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun T' ↦ -Real.log (zcb r t T')) r T
proof:
:= by
  have h_eq : ∀ T' : ℝ, -Real.log (zcb r t T') = r * (T' - t) := by
    intro T'
    show -Real.log (Real.exp (-(r * (T' - t)))) = r * (T' - t)
    rw [Real.log_exp]
    ring
  have h_lin : HasDerivAt (fun T' : ℝ ↦ r * (T' - t)) r T := by
    have h := ((hasDerivAt_id T).sub_const t).const_mul r
    simpa using h
  exact h_lin.congr_of_eventuallyEq (Filter.Eventually.of_forall h_eq)

name: couponBondPrice_strictAnti
statement:
lemma couponBondPrice_strictAnti
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (c T : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (h_pos : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < c i)
    (h_future : ∀ i ∈ s, t < T i)
    (h_nonempty : s.Nonempty) :
    StrictAnti (fun r ↦ ∑ i ∈ s, c i * Real.exp (-(r * (T i - t))))
proof:
:= by
  intro r₁ r₂ hr
  apply Finset.sum_lt_sum_of_nonempty h_nonempty
  intro i hi
  have h_diff : 0 < T i - t := sub_pos.mpr (h_future i hi)
  have h_arg : -(r₂ * (T i - t)) < -(r₁ * (T i - t)) := by
    have : r₁ * (T i - t) < r₂ * (T i - t) := by
      exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_right hr h_diff
    linarith
  have h_exp_lt : Real.exp (-(r₂ * (T i - t))) < Real.exp (-(r₁ * (T i - t))) :=
    Real.exp_lt_exp.mpr h_arg
  exact mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h_exp_lt (h_pos i hi)

name: hasDerivAt_bondPortfolioValue_r
statement:
lemma hasDerivAt_bondPortfolioValue_r
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (w T : ι → ℝ) (t r : ℝ) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦ bondPortfolioValue s w T t r')
      (-bondPortfolioDur s w T t r) r
proof:
:= by
  unfold bondPortfolioValue bondPortfolioDur
  have h_each : ∀ i ∈ s, HasDerivAt
      (fun r' ↦ w i * Real.exp (-(r' * (T i - t))))
      (-(w i * (T i - t) * Real.exp (-(r * (T i - t))))) r := by
    intro i _
    
    
    have h := (hasDerivAt_zcb_r t (T i) r).const_mul (w i)
    simp only [zcb] at h
    convert h using 1 <;> first | rfl | ring
  have h_raw := HasDerivAt.fun_sum h_each
  rw [Finset.sum_neg_distrib] at h_raw
  exact h_raw

name: bondPortfolio_single_bond_dur
statement:
lemma bondPortfolio_single_bond_dur
    {ι : Type*} (i : ι) (w T : ι → ℝ) (t r : ℝ) :
    bondPortfolioDur {i} w T t r =
      w i * (T i - t) * Real.exp (-(r * (T i - t)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bondPortfolioDur
  simp

name: bondPortfolio_single_bond_value
statement:
lemma bondPortfolio_single_bond_value
    {ι : Type*} (i : ι) (w T : ι → ℝ) (t r : ℝ) :
    bondPortfolioValue {i} w T t r = w i * Real.exp (-(r * (T i - t)))
proof:
:= by
  unfold bondPortfolioValue
  simp

name: bondPortfolio_immunization_first_order
statement:
lemma bondPortfolio_immunization_first_order
    {ι κ : Type*}
    (sA : Finset ι) (wA TA : ι → ℝ)
    (sL : Finset κ) (wL TL : κ → ℝ)
    (t r : ℝ)
    (h_match : bondPortfolioDur sA wA TA t r =
               bondPortfolioDur sL wL TL t r) :
    HasDerivAt (fun r' ↦
        bondPortfolioValue sA wA TA t r' -
        bondPortfolioValue sL wL TL t r')
      0 r
proof:
:= by
  have hA := hasDerivAt_bondPortfolioValue_r sA wA TA t r
  have hL := hasDerivAt_bondPortfolioValue_r sL wL TL t r
  have h := hA.sub hL
  rw [show (0 : ℝ) = -bondPortfolioDur sA wA TA t r - -bondPortfolioDur sL wL TL t r from by
    rw [h_match]; ring]
  exact h

name: annuity_pos
statement:
theorem annuity_pos {ι : Type*} {δ : ℝ} {P : ι → ℝ} {s : Finset ι} (hδ : 0 < δ)
    (hP : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 < P i) (hs : s.Nonempty) : 0 < annuity δ P s
proof:
:=
  mul_pos hδ (Finset.sum_pos hP hs)

name: payerSwapValue_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem payerSwapValue_eq_zero_iff (P0 Pn K : ℝ) {A : ℝ} (hA : A ≠ 0) :
    payerSwapValue P0 Pn K A = 0 ↔ K = parSwapRate P0 Pn A
proof:
:= by
  show P0 - Pn - K * A = 0 ↔ K = (P0 - Pn) / A
  rw [sub_eq_zero, eq_div_iff hA]
  exact eq_comm

name: payerSwapValue_zcb_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem payerSwapValue_zcb_eq_zero_iff {ι : Type*} (r δ K T0 Tn : ℝ) (T : ι → ℝ)
    (s : Finset ι) (hδ : 0 < δ) (hs : s.Nonempty) :
    payerSwapValue (zcb r 0 T0) (zcb r 0 Tn) K (annuity δ (fun i ↦ zcb r 0 (T i)) s) = 0 ↔
      K = parSwapRate (zcb r 0 T0) (zcb r 0 Tn) (annuity δ (fun i ↦ zcb r 0 (T i)) s)
proof:
:=
  payerSwapValue_eq_zero_iff _ _ _
    (annuity_pos hδ (fun i _ ↦ zcb_pos r 0 (T i)) hs).ne'

name: fraValue_forwardRate_eq_discount_difference
statement:
theorem fraValue_forwardRate_eq_discount_difference (P1 P2 δ K : ℝ)
    (hδ : δ ≠ 0) (hP2 : P2 ≠ 0) :
    fraValue δ P2 (fraForwardRate P1 P2 δ) K = P1 - P2 - δ * P2 * K
proof:
:= by
  unfold fraValue fraForwardRate
  field_simp

name: fraValue_zcb_eq_discount_difference
statement:
theorem fraValue_zcb_eq_discount_difference (r δ K T1 T2 : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    fraValue δ (zcb r 0 T2) (fraForwardRate (zcb r 0 T1) (zcb r 0 T2) δ) K =
      zcb r 0 T1 - zcb r 0 T2 - δ * zcb r 0 T2 * K
proof:
:=
  fraValue_forwardRate_eq_discount_difference _ _ _ _ hδ (zcb_pos r 0 T2).ne'

name: fraValue_zcb_eq_zero_iff
statement:
theorem fraValue_zcb_eq_zero_iff (r δ K T1 T2 : ℝ) (hδ : δ ≠ 0) :
    fraValue δ (zcb r 0 T2) (fraForwardRate (zcb r 0 T1) (zcb r 0 T2) δ) K = 0 ↔
      K = fraForwardRate (zcb r 0 T1) (zcb r 0 T2) δ
proof:
:= by
  unfold fraValue
  have hscale : δ * zcb r 0 T2 ≠ 0 := mul_ne_zero hδ (zcb_pos r 0 T2).ne'
  constructor
  · intro h
    rcases mul_eq_zero.mp h with h | h
    · exact (hscale h).elim
    · exact (sub_eq_zero.mp h).symm
  · intro h
    rw [h, sub_self, mul_zero]

name: gaussianVaR_affine
statement:
lemma gaussianVaR_affine (μ σ z a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    gaussianVaR (a * μ + b) (|a| * σ) z = a * gaussianVaR μ σ z + b
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianVaR
  rw [abs_of_nonneg ha]; ring

name: gaussianCVaR_affine
statement:
lemma gaussianCVaR_affine (μ σ z α a b : ℝ) (ha : 0 ≤ a) :
    gaussianCVaR (a * μ + b) (|a| * σ) z α = a * gaussianCVaR μ σ z α + b
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianCVaR
  rw [abs_of_nonneg ha]; ring

name: gaussianVaR_standard
statement: lemma gaussianVaR_standard (z : ℝ) : gaussianVaR 0 1 z = z
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianVaR; ring

name: gaussianCVaR_standard
statement:
lemma gaussianCVaR_standard (z α : ℝ) :
    gaussianCVaR 0 1 z α = gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z / (1 - α)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianCVaR; ring

name: gaussianCVaR_sub_VaR
statement:
lemma gaussianCVaR_sub_VaR (μ σ z α : ℝ) :
    gaussianCVaR μ σ z α - gaussianVaR μ σ z =
      σ * (gaussianPDFReal 0 1 z / (1 - α) - z)
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianCVaR gaussianVaR
  ring

name: gaussianVaR_volatility_scaling
statement:
lemma gaussianVaR_volatility_scaling (μ σ z T : ℝ) :
    gaussianVaR (T * μ) (σ * Real.sqrt T) z = T * μ + σ * Real.sqrt T * z
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianVaR
  ring

name: herfindahl_nonneg
statement:
lemma herfindahl_nonneg (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ) :
    0 ≤ herfindahl s w
proof:
:= by
  unfold herfindahl
  apply Finset.sum_nonneg
  intros i _
  exact sq_nonneg _

name: herfindahl_le_one_of_sum_le_one_of_nonneg
statement:
lemma herfindahl_le_one_of_sum_le_one_of_nonneg
    (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hnn : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ w i) (hw_le : ∀ i ∈ s, w i ≤ 1)
    (h_sum : ∑ i ∈ s, w i ≤ 1) :
    herfindahl s w ≤ 1
proof:
:= by
  unfold herfindahl
  
  
  have h_bound : ∀ i ∈ s, (w i)^2 ≤ w i := fun i hi ↦
    pow_le_of_le_one (hnn i hi) (hw_le i hi) (by norm_num)
  calc ∑ i ∈ s, (w i)^2
      ≤ ∑ i ∈ s, w i := Finset.sum_le_sum h_bound
    _ ≤ 1 := h_sum

name: herfindahl_card_inv_le_of_sum_one
statement:
lemma herfindahl_card_inv_le_of_sum_one (s : Finset ι) (w : ι → ℝ)
    (hs : s.Nonempty) (h_sum : ∑ i ∈ s, w i = 1) :
    (s.card : ℝ)⁻¹ ≤ herfindahl s w
proof:
:= by
  unfold herfindahl
  
  have h_cs : (∑ i ∈ s, w i) ^ 2 ≤ (s.card : ℝ) * ∑ i ∈ s, (w i) ^ 2 :=
    sq_sum_le_card_mul_sum_sq
  rw [h_sum, one_pow] at h_cs
  
  have h_card_pos : 0 < (s.card : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hs.card_pos
  rw [inv_le_iff_one_le_mul₀ h_card_pos]
  linarith

name: le_worstCase
statement: lemma le_worstCase (X : ι → ℝ) (i : ι) : - X i ≤ worstCase X
proof:
:=
  Finset.le_sup' (fun i ↦ - X i) (Finset.mem_univ i)

name: worstCase_le
statement: lemma worstCase_le {X : ι → ℝ} {a : ℝ} (h : ∀ i, - X i ≤ a) : worstCase X ≤ a
proof:
:=
  Finset.sup'_le Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i ↦ - X i) (fun i _ ↦ h i)

name: worstCase_isCoherent
statement: lemma worstCase_isCoherent : IsCoherentRisk (worstCase (ι := ι))
proof:
:= by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · intro X Y hXY
    exact worstCase_le (fun i ↦ le_trans (neg_le_neg (hXY i)) (le_worstCase X i))
  · intro X m
    apply le_antisymm
    · exact worstCase_le (fun i ↦ by
        show - (X i + m) ≤ worstCase X - m
        linarith [le_worstCase X i])
    · obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i ↦ - X i)
      have hwx : worstCase X = - X i := hi
      have h2 : - (X i + m) ≤ worstCase (fun i ↦ X i + m) := le_worstCase (fun i ↦ X i + m) i
      rw [hwx]; linarith [h2]
  · intro l hl X
    apply le_antisymm
    · refine worstCase_le (fun i ↦ ?_)
      have hsmul : - (l • X) i = l * (- X i) := by simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg]
      rw [hsmul]
      exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (le_worstCase X i) hl
    · obtain ⟨i, _, hi⟩ := Finset.exists_mem_eq_sup' Finset.univ_nonempty (fun i ↦ - X i)
      have hwx : worstCase X = - X i := hi
      have hsmul : - (l • X) i = l * (- X i) := by simp [Pi.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, mul_neg]
      have h2 : - (l • X) i ≤ worstCase (l • X) := le_worstCase (l • X) i
      rw [hwx]
      rw [hsmul] at h2
      exact h2
  · intro X Y
    refine worstCase_le (fun i ↦ ?_)
    have hx := le_worstCase X i
    have hy := le_worstCase Y i
    simp only [Pi.add_apply, neg_add_rev]
    linarith

name: representingSet_worstCase
statement:
lemma representingSet_worstCase :
    representingSet (worstCase (ι := ι)) = stdSimplex ℝ ι
proof:
:= by
  ext q
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨hnn, hsum, _⟩; exact ⟨hnn, hsum⟩
  · rintro ⟨hnn, hsum⟩
    refine ⟨hnn, hsum, fun Z hZ ↦ ?_⟩
    refine Finset.sum_nonneg (fun i _ ↦ mul_nonneg (hnn i) ?_)
    have h1 : - Z i ≤ worstCase Z := le_worstCase Z i
    have h2 : worstCase Z ≤ 0 := hZ
    linarith

name: worstCase_isLUB
statement:
theorem worstCase_isLUB (X : ι → ℝ) :
    IsLUB ((fun q ↦ ∑ i, q i * (- X i)) '' stdSimplex ℝ ι) (worstCase X)
proof:
:= by
  rw [← representingSet_worstCase]
  exact coherentRisk_isLUB worstCase_isCoherent X

name: gaussianVaR_additive_at_rho_one
statement:
lemma gaussianVaR_additive_at_rho_one {μ₁ μ₂ σ₁ σ₂ z : ℝ}
    (h₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁) (h₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) :
    gaussianVaR (μ₁ + μ₂)
        (Real.sqrt (σ₁^2 + 2 * 1 * σ₁ * σ₂ + σ₂^2)) z =
      gaussianVaR μ₁ σ₁ z + gaussianVaR μ₂ σ₂ z
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianVaR
  have h_sum_sq : σ₁^2 + 2 * 1 * σ₁ * σ₂ + σ₂^2 = (σ₁ + σ₂)^2 := by ring
  rw [h_sum_sq]
  have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ σ₁ + σ₂ := add_nonneg h₁ h₂
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq h_sum_nn]
  ring

name: gaussianCVaR_additive_at_rho_one
statement:
lemma gaussianCVaR_additive_at_rho_one {μ₁ μ₂ σ₁ σ₂ z α : ℝ}
    (h₁ : 0 ≤ σ₁) (h₂ : 0 ≤ σ₂) :
    gaussianCVaR (μ₁ + μ₂)
        (Real.sqrt (σ₁^2 + 2 * 1 * σ₁ * σ₂ + σ₂^2)) z α =
      gaussianCVaR μ₁ σ₁ z α + gaussianCVaR μ₂ σ₂ z α
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianCVaR
  have h_sum_sq : σ₁^2 + 2 * 1 * σ₁ * σ₂ + σ₂^2 = (σ₁ + σ₂)^2 := by ring
  rw [h_sum_sq]
  have h_sum_nn : 0 ≤ σ₁ + σ₂ := add_nonneg h₁ h₂
  rw [Real.sqrt_sq h_sum_nn]
  ring

name: acceptableUnderUtility_convex
statement:
theorem acceptableUnderUtility_convex
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℝ)
    (hp_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i)
    (h_concave : ∀ x y : ℝ, ∀ α : ℝ, 0 ≤ α → α ≤ 1 →
      α * u x + (1 - α) * u y ≤ u (α * x + (1 - α) * y))
    {X Y : ι → ℝ} {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α) (hα1 : α ≤ 1)
    (hX : acceptableUnderUtility s p u W X)
    (hY : acceptableUnderUtility s p u W Y) :
    acceptableUnderUtility s p u W (fun i ↦ α * X i + (1 - α) * Y i)
proof:
:= by
  unfold acceptableUnderUtility at *
  have h_ptwise : ∀ i ∈ s,
      α * u (W + X i) + (1 - α) * u (W + Y i) ≤
      u (W + (α * X i + (1 - α) * Y i)) := by
    intro i _
    have h := h_concave (W + X i) (W + Y i) α hα hα1
    convert h using 2
    ring
  have h_p_mult : ∀ i ∈ s,
      p i * (α * u (W + X i) + (1 - α) * u (W + Y i)) ≤
      p i * u (W + (α * X i + (1 - α) * Y i)) := by
    intro i hi
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_ptwise i hi) (hp_nonneg i hi)
  have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_p_mult
  have h_LHS :
      ∑ i ∈ s, p i * (α * u (W + X i) + (1 - α) * u (W + Y i)) =
      α * (∑ i ∈ s, p i * u (W + X i)) +
        (1 - α) * (∑ i ∈ s, p i * u (W + Y i)) := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ by ring)
  rw [h_LHS] at h_sum
  have h_target : α * u W + (1 - α) * u W = u W := by ring
  have h_bound : α * u W + (1 - α) * u W ≤
                 α * (∑ i ∈ s, p i * u (W + X i)) +
                   (1 - α) * (∑ i ∈ s, p i * u (W + Y i)) := by
    have h1 : α * u W ≤ α * (∑ i ∈ s, p i * u (W + X i)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hX hα
    have h2 : (1 - α) * u W ≤ (1 - α) * (∑ i ∈ s, p i * u (W + Y i)) :=
      mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left hY (by linarith)
    linarith
  linarith

name: acceptableUnderUtility_monotone_translation
statement:
theorem acceptableUnderUtility_monotone_translation
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℝ)
    (hp_nonneg : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ p i)
    (h_mono : Monotone u)
    {X : ι → ℝ} {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c)
    (hX : acceptableUnderUtility s p u W X) :
    acceptableUnderUtility s p u W (fun i ↦ X i + c)
proof:
:= by
  unfold acceptableUnderUtility at *
  have h_ptwise : ∀ i ∈ s, u (W + X i) ≤ u (W + (X i + c)) := by
    intro i _
    apply h_mono
    linarith
  have h_p_mult : ∀ i ∈ s, p i * u (W + X i) ≤ p i * u (W + (X i + c)) := by
    intro i hi
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (h_ptwise i hi) (hp_nonneg i hi)
  have h_sum := Finset.sum_le_sum h_p_mult
  linarith

name: acceptableUnderUtility_zero
statement:
theorem acceptableUnderUtility_zero
    {ι : Type*} (s : Finset ι) (p : ι → ℝ) (u : ℝ → ℝ) (W : ℝ)
    (h_p_sum : ∑ i ∈ s, p i = 1) :
    acceptableUnderUtility s p u W (fun _ ↦ 0)
proof:
:= by
  unfold acceptableUnderUtility
  simp only [add_zero]
  rw [← Finset.sum_mul, h_p_sum, one_mul]

name: spectralRisk_translation
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_translation (s : Finset ι) (φ : ι → ℝ) (Q : ι → ℝ)
    (c : ℝ) (h_norm : ∑ i ∈ s, φ i = 1) :
    spectralRiskFinite s φ (fun i ↦ Q i + c) =
      spectralRiskFinite s φ Q + c
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralRiskFinite
  rw [show (fun i ↦ φ i * (Q i + c)) = (fun i ↦ φ i * Q i + φ i * c) from by
        funext i; ring]
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.sum_mul, h_norm, one_mul]

name: spectralRisk_mono
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_mono (s : Finset ι) (φ Q Q' : ι → ℝ)
    (hφ : ∀ i ∈ s, 0 ≤ φ i) (hQ : ∀ i ∈ s, Q i ≤ Q' i) :
    spectralRiskFinite s φ Q ≤ spectralRiskFinite s φ Q'
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralRiskFinite
  exact Finset.sum_le_sum fun i hi ↦
    mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (hQ i hi) (hφ i hi)

name: spectralRisk_convex_combination_normalized
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_convex_combination_normalized
    (s : Finset ι) (φ ψ : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ)
    (hφ : ∑ i ∈ s, φ i = 1) (hψ : ∑ i ∈ s, ψ i = 1) :
    ∑ i ∈ s, (t * φ i + (1 - t) * ψ i) = 1
proof:
:= by
  rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib, ← Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.mul_sum, hφ, hψ]
  ring

name: spectralRisk_convex_combination
statement:
theorem spectralRisk_convex_combination
    (s : Finset ι) (φ ψ : ι → ℝ) (Q : ι → ℝ) (t : ℝ) :
    t * spectralRiskFinite s φ Q + (1 - t) * spectralRiskFinite s ψ Q =
      spectralRiskFinite s (fun i ↦ t * φ i + (1 - t) * ψ i) Q
proof:
:= by
  unfold spectralRiskFinite
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  refine Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ ?_)
  ring

name: mix_one
statement: theorem mix_one (p q : ι → ℝ) : mix 1 p q = p
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [mix]

name: mix_zero
statement: theorem mix_zero (p q : ι → ℝ) : mix 0 p q = q
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  simp [mix]

name: mix_self
statement: theorem mix_self (α : ℝ) (p : ι → ℝ) : mix α p p = p
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  show α * p i + (1 - α) * p i = p i
  ring

name: mix_comm
statement: theorem mix_comm (α : ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) : mix α p q = mix (1 - α) q p
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  show α * p i + (1 - α) * q i = (1 - α) * q i + (1 - (1 - α)) * p i
  ring

name: mix_compound
statement:
theorem mix_compound (α β : ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) :
    mix α (mix β p q) q = mix (α * β) p q
proof:
:= by
  funext i
  show α * (β * p i + (1 - β) * q i) + (1 - α) * q i
      = α * β * p i + (1 - α * β) * q i
  ring

name: mix_nonneg
proof:
:= by
  show 0 ≤ α * p i + (1 - α) * q i
  exact add_nonneg (mul_nonneg hα (hp i)) (mul_nonneg (by linarith) (hq i))

name: sum_mix
proof:
:= by
  have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ s, mix α p q i
      = α * (∑ i ∈ s, p i) + (1 - α) * ∑ i ∈ s, q i := by
    simp only [mix]
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  rw [hsplit, hp, hq]
  ring

name: expectedUtility_mix
statement:
theorem expectedUtility_mix (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (α : ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) :
    expectedUtility s u (mix α p q)
      = α * expectedUtility s u p + (1 - α) * expectedUtility s u q
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expectedUtility, mix]
  rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
  exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ by ring)

name: prefersEU_total
statement:
theorem prefersEU_total (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (p q : ι → ℝ) :
    prefersEU s u p q ∨ prefersEU s u q p
proof:
:=
  le_total _ _

name: prefersEU_trans
statement:
theorem prefersEU_trans (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) {p q r : ι → ℝ}
    (hpq : prefersEU s u p q) (hqr : prefersEU s u q r) : prefersEU s u p r
proof:
:=
  le_trans hqr hpq

name: prefersEU_refl
statement:
theorem prefersEU_refl (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (p : ι → ℝ) :
    prefersEU s u p p
proof:
:=
  le_refl _

name: prefersEU_independence
statement:
theorem prefersEU_independence (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) {α : ℝ} (hα : 0 ≤ α)
    {p q r : ι → ℝ} (h : prefersEU s u p q) :
    prefersEU s u (mix α p r) (mix α q r)
proof:
:= by
  unfold prefersEU at h ⊢
  rw [expectedUtility_mix, expectedUtility_mix]
  exact add_le_add (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h hα) le_rfl

name: prefersEU_strict_independence
proof:
:= by
  rw [expectedUtility_mix, expectedUtility_mix]
  exact add_lt_add_of_lt_of_le (mul_lt_mul_of_pos_left h hα) le_rfl

name: exists_mix_weight
statement:
theorem exists_mix_weight {P Q R : ℝ} (hpq : Q < P) (hqr : R < Q) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧ α * P + (1 - α) * R = Q
proof:
:= by
  have hPR : 0 < P - R := by linarith
  have hne : P - R ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt hPR
  refine ⟨(Q - R) / (P - R), div_pos (by linarith) hPR, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [div_lt_one hPR]
    linarith
  · have key : (Q - R) / (P - R) * (P - R) = Q - R := by
      field_simp
    linear_combination key

name: prefersEU_continuity
statement:
theorem prefersEU_continuity (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) {p q r : ι → ℝ}
    (hpq : expectedUtility s u q < expectedUtility s u p)
    (hqr : expectedUtility s u r < expectedUtility s u q) :
    ∃ α : ℝ, 0 < α ∧ α < 1 ∧
      expectedUtility s u (mix α p r) = expectedUtility s u q
proof:
:= by
  obtain ⟨α, hα0, hα1, hα⟩ := exists_mix_weight hpq hqr
  refine ⟨α, hα0, hα1, ?_⟩
  rw [expectedUtility_mix]
  exact hα

name: expectedUtility_affine
statement:
theorem expectedUtility_affine (s : Finset ι) (u : ι → ℝ) (a b : ℝ) {p : ι → ℝ}
    (hp : ∑ i ∈ s, p i = 1) :
    expectedUtility s (fun i ↦ a * u i + b) p
      = a * expectedUtility s u p + b
proof:
:= by
  simp only [expectedUtility]
  have hsplit : ∑ i ∈ s, p i * (a * u i + b)
      = a * (∑ i ∈ s, p i * u i) + b * ∑ i ∈ s, p i := by
    rw [Finset.mul_sum, Finset.mul_sum, ← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun i _ ↦ by ring)
  rw [hsplit, hp]
  ring

name: prefersEU_affine_invariant
proof:
:= by
  unfold prefersEU
  rw [expectedUtility_affine s u a b hp, expectedUtility_affine s u a b hq,
    add_le_add_iff_right, mul_le_mul_iff_of_pos_left ha]

name: gaussianVaR_monotone_mean
proof:
:= by
  unfold gaussianVaR
  linarith

name: gaussianCVaR_monotone_mean
proof:
:= by
